blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Masked diffusion models (MDMs) generate text by unmasking several tokens per step, but they are trained and sampled under different conditions.
The model is trained on randomly masked sequences, whereas inference follows a trajectory shaped by the model’s own predictions. Additionally, each step has no access to what the previous one computed.
Recent methods narrow these limitations from separate angles, leaving open how these choices interact.
We introduce PUMBA, a unified framework for trajectory-aware training that trains the denoiser on consecutive steps of policy-induced trajectories, passes information between steps, and optimizes them jointly by backpropagation through time.
A controlled study of this design space shows that i) exact train–inference alignment fails due to local overfitting, whereas a looser alignment still brings training masks closer to those seen at inference; ii) passing continuous information outperforms discrete gradient estimators through the commitment at each step; and iii) performance improves as backpropagation through time spans more steps, which we support theoretically.
Combined, these components match the best checkpoint of a same-size autoregressive model.
Building on these findings, we scale PUMBA to supervised fine-tuning of LLaDA-8B, where it improves the trade-off between performance and number of function evaluations (NFEs) in both full-canvas and block diffusion generation.
At matched performance, it needs up to 22% fewer NFEs than standard fine-tuning with twice the budget in full-canvas generation, and up to 26% fewer than standard fine-tuning for the same number of steps in block diffusion.
blocks.zh:
蒙面扩散模型(MDMs)通过每步揭开数个符号来生成文本,但它们在不同的条件下受到训练和取样.
模型以随机遮掩的序列来训练,而推论则遵循模型自己预测形成的轨迹. 此外,每一步骤都无法获得前一个步骤的计算结果。
最近的方法从不同的角度缩小了这些限制,留下了这些选择如何相互作用的空洞.
我们引入了PUMBA,一个统一的轨道意识训练框架,它训练德诺瓦人连续步政策引起的轨迹,在步间传递信息,并通过时间的反向传播共同优化.
对这一设计空间的受控研究表明,一) 准确的列车-推论调整因局部偏差而失败,而松散的调整仍使训练口罩更接近于推论中看到的口罩;二) 通过每一步的承诺传递连续的信息比离散的梯度估计器要好;三) 随着反射跨度延长,性能得到改善,我们在理论上支持这些步骤。
综合起来,这些组件匹配了同样大小的自动递归模式的最佳检查站.
根据这些调查结果,我们扩大了PUMBA的规模,以监督LLaDA-8B的微调,在全扫描和块传播生成中,它改善了性能与功能评价数量之间的权衡。
在匹配的性能下,它需要比标准微调低22%的NFE,在全扫描仪生成时其预算是预算的两倍,在区块扩散中同样数量的步骤比标准微调低26%。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Masked diffusion models (MDMs) ( Shi et al., 2024 ; Sahoo et al., 2024 ) generate text by iteratively unmasking several tokens at a time, and have recently been scaled up ( Nie et al., 2025 ; Ye et al., 2025 ; Inception Labs, 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026b ; Nie et al., 2026 ; Bie et al., 2025 ) .
These models are trained to unmask partially masked sequences with randomly drawn masks.
At inference, however, an unmasking policy uses the model’s predictions to decide which positions to reveal iteratively.
This disagreement between training and inference opens two gaps.
First, the model and policy jointly shape the inference trajectory, whose states differ from the training distribution ( Figure 1 ).
Second, since training sequences are drawn independently, the model never learns to use information from previous steps.
Recent work addresses these gaps in different ways: by passing continuous information between steps ( Jo et al., 2026 ; Hu et al., 2026 ) ; by training along trajectories induced by the inference policy, known as Progressive Unmasking (PU) 1 1 1 PU denotes the progressive unmasking framework; PUMA denotes the instantiation of Kim et al. (2026) , which randomizes and anneals the number of tokens revealed per step. ( Kim et al., 2026 ) ; and by training on several consecutive steps jointly ( Xia et al., 2026 ; Rozonoyer et al., 2026 ).
blocks.zh:
Masked扩散模型(Shi等人,2024年;Sahoo等人,2024年)通过一次迭代解析数个标语生成文本,最近也得到了扩大(Nie等人,2025年;Ye等人,2025年;Inception Labs,2025年;Wu等人,2026年b;Nie等人,2026年;Bie等人,2025年)。
这些模型被训练为用随机抽取的口罩来解开部分蒙面序列.
然而,根据推论,一项不装模作样的政策利用模型的预测来决定哪些立场可以反复揭示。
培训和推论之间的这种分歧造成了两个差距。
首先,模型和政策共同决定了推断轨迹,其状态不同于培训分布(图1)。
第二,由于训练序列是独立抽取的,所以该模型从未学会使用以前步骤中的信息.
最近的工作以不同的方式解决了这些差距:通过在步骤之间传递连续的信息(Jo等人,2026年;Hu等人,2026年);通过按照推论政策引发的轨迹进行培训,称为进步解码(PU)11 1 PU表示进步解码框架;PUMA表示对Kim等人的即时解码(2026年),这种解码随机化,对每个步骤所揭示的符号数量进行反射. (Kim等人,2026年);和通过连续几个步骤的联合培训(Xia等人,2026年;Rozonoyer等人,2026年)。

MDM trains on one independently masked 𝐱 t \mathbf{x}_{t} .

We unify these approaches in a single formulation of trajectory-aware training, which we name PUMBA (Progressive UnMasking with Backpropagation Across steps), where the denoiser is trained on consecutive steps of a trajectory rather than isolated sequences ( Section 3 ).
It spans three axes: the policy that builds each training trajectory; the carry , i.e. the information one step passes to the next; and the window W W of consecutive steps whose losses are optimized jointly by backpropagation through time (BPTT). Prior methods each address some of these axes.
blocks.zh:
我们把这些方法统一为一种单一的轨迹意识训练,我们称之为 " PUMBA " ( " 渐进式卸载式反扩散跨步骤 " ),其中 " 阴茎 " 接受轨迹连续步骤训练,而不是孤立序列训练(第3节)。
它跨越三条轴线:构建每条训练轨迹的政策;承载,即信息一步传到下一步;连续步骤的W W 窗口,其损失通过穿越时间的反向传播(BPTT)共同优化. 先前的方法都涉及其中的一些轴。

blocks.en:
To map this space, we first study a controlled setting where we train on TinyGSM ( Liu et al., 2023 ) and evaluate on GSM8K ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) , analyzing how each axis contributes to reasoning performance ( Section 3 ).
First, we identify a local overfitting phenomenon that prevents PU from revealing as few tokens per step in training as at inference ( Section 3.1 ). We show that even when training reveals several times more tokens per step, PU still reduces the train–inference mask discrepancy.
Second, we demonstrate that a continuous carry is the most effective way to cross the discrete commitment at each unmasking step ( Section 3.2 ).
Third, performance improves as W W grows, which we support theoretically.
Crucially, the three axes compound: each adds generative performance at every decoding budget. Together they match the performance of an autoregressive (AR) model of the same size trained on the same data, while decoding more than one token per step.
blocks.zh:
为了绘制这个空间,我们首先研究一个控制环境,在TinyGSM(Liu等人,2023年)上进行训练,并在GSM8K(Cobbe等人,2021年)上进行评估,分析每个轴对推理性能的贡献(第3节).
首先,我们发现一种局部的过度适应现象,它使PU无法在训练中每步显示很少的标志(第3.1节)。 我们显示,即使每步训练会显示几倍多的符号,PU仍然会减少列车 — — 推论掩盖差异.
第二,我们表明,连续承担是在每个不露面步骤上跨越独立承诺的最有效方式(第3.2节)。
第三,随着WW的增长,性能得到了提高,我们理论上支持.
关键的是,三轴复合物:每个元件在每个解码预算中都增加了基因性能. 它们共同匹配了在相同数据上训练的同样大小的自动递归(AR)模型的性能,同时每步解码一个以上的令牌.

blocks.en:
Building on these findings, we scale PUMBA to the supervised fine-tuning (SFT) setting using LLaDA-8B-Base as the base model ( Nie et al., 2025 ) , in both full-canvas and block diffusion formulations ( Section 4 ).
To the best of our knowledge, this is the first trajectory-aware SFT at this scale (full tuning of all 8B parameters, 4096-token sequences, on a 1.8B-token general-purpose instruction dataset).
PUMBA suits SFT, which is data-constrained: further epochs soon yield little.
Guided by the controlled study and the failure modes of PU at this scale, we design a PUMBA instantiation that pushes the performance versus number of function evaluations (NFEs) Pareto frontier beyond standard SFT on reasoning and instruction following.
In full-canvas generation, 4000 steps of PUMBA improve performance three times as much as doubling the SFT budget, in less training time.
At matched performance, PUMBA needs up to 22 % 22\% fewer NFEs than an SFT run twice as long in full-canvas generation, and up to 26 % 26\% fewer in block diffusion than an MDM control trained as long.
blocks.zh:
根据这些调查结果,我们利用LLaDA-8B-Base作为基准模型(Nie等人,2025年),将PUMBA扩大为有监督的微调(SFT)设置,包括全扫描和块扩散配方(第4节)。
据我们所知,这是这个尺度上第一个具有轨迹意识的SFT(完全调整所有8B参数,4096-token序列,在一个1.8B-token通用指令数据集上).
PUMBA suits SFT 数据受限:进一步的时代很快收效甚微.
在受控研究和PU在这个规模上的故障模式的指导下,我们设计了一个PUMBA即时分析,将性能与函数评价(NFEs)帕雷托边框的数量推向关于推理和指示的标准SFT之外。
在全canvas生成中,PUMBA的4000步提高性能是SFT预算的两倍,在更少的训练时间内.
在匹配的性能下,PUMBA需要的NFE比SFT在全扫描仪生成时运行的两倍少22% 22 Q,在区块扩散方面比训练的MDM控制要少26% 26 Q。

Generation starts from the fully masked sequence and reveals tokens over multiple steps.
We index steps by j j and write 𝐱 t j \mathbf{x}_{t_{j}} for the sequence after step j j , whose level is its masking ratio t j = | ℳ ⁡ ( 𝐱 t j ) | / L t_{j}=|\mathcal{M}(\mathbf{x}_{t_{j}})|/L .

Revealing several positions at once trades exactness for speed by sampling from the product of their marginals rather than the joint distribution ( Webb et al., 2026 ) .
Choosing the most confident positions keeps this product closer to the joint distribution and improves samples at a fixed number of steps ( Nie et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026b ) .

We use this policy for the controlled experiments ( Section 3 ).
For larger MDMs, Fast-dLLM ( Wu et al., 2026b ; Wu et al., 2026a ) is an effective policy that reveals every position with c i ≥ τ c_{i}\geq\tau , or the single most confident one if none qualifies.
Combined with block diffusion decoding, which proceeds from left to right, block by block ( Arriola et al., 2025 ) , it preserves generation quality at far fewer denoiser calls, or number of function evaluations (NFEs) , per sample.
We therefore adopt it as the inference policy for LLaDA in Section 4 . See Appendix A for an extended version.

blocks.en: 3 Elucidating the Design Space of PUMBA
blocks.zh: 3个 缩小 PUMBA 的设计空间

blocks.en:
We map the design space of PUMBA in a controlled setting following Kim et al. (2026) : we train a 125M-parameter bidirectional transformer from scratch on TinyGSM ( Liu et al., 2023 ) for 20 epochs and evaluate zero-shot on GSM8K ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) with the top- u u policy ( Section 2 ).
All variants share the same architecture, data, batch size, and learning rate.
blocks.zh:
我们在金等人(2026年)之后的控制环境下绘制了PUMBA的设计空间图:我们在TinyGSM(Liu等人,2023年)上从头开始训练125M参数双向变压器,用于20个纪元,并在GSM8K(Cobbe等人,2021年)上以最高-u-u政策(第2节)进行零射评价.
所有变体共享相同的架构,数据,批量大小,以及学习率.

blocks.en: 3.1 Training–Inference Alignment via Progressive Unmasking
blocks.zh: 3.1 通过逐步解密使培训与推论一致

blocks.en:
Standard MDM training masks sequences independently of the model, whereas inference visits the sequences that the denoiser and the unmasking policy dictate.
Training and inference therefore encounter different distributions of masking patterns.
The patterns at inference time depend on the reveal count u u .
In practice, the effective inference u u is small, since otherwise the product of marginals becomes a poor approximation of the joint distribution of the unmasked tokens, and generation quality degrades ( Webb et al., 2026 ) .
For example, on TinyGSM, the accuracy of every variant we train peaks at u ∈ { 2 , 3 , 4 } u\in\{2,3,4\} and roughly halves by u = 16 u{=}16 ( Figure 7 , left ).
Similar trends hold for larger models ( Kang et al., 2026 ) .
The regime of interest is therefore a rather small u u .
Ideally, training would visit the same sequences as inference does at this u u .

blocks.en:
Progressive unmasking (PU) ( Kim et al., 2026 ) aims at exactly this: instead of the independent corruptions of Eq. 2.1 , it trains on the trajectory that the inference policy itself produces.
For each sample, training starts from the fully masked sequence.
At each optimizer step, we compute the loss on the current sequence and then use the inference-time unmasking policy to reveal more positions.
The resulting sequence is used in the next step, and this continues until the sample is fully revealed, after which a new sample is used.
Many consecutive training examples thus come from the same trajectory rather than from multiple data samples with independent mask patterns.
Each step still requires one denoiser call, and trajectories can be batched and progressively unmasked in parallel ( Figure 2 , left ).
blocks.zh:
渐进式的揭发(PU)(Kim et al., 2026年)正是以此为目标的:与其说是Eq 2.1的独立腐败,不如说是用推论政策本身产生的轨迹来训练。
对于每个样本,训练从完全遮掩的序列开始.
在每一个优化步骤上,我们计算当前序列的损失,然后使用推论时的解伪政策来揭示更多的位置.
由此产生的序列在下一步使用,这一直持续到样品完全暴露出来,然后使用新的样品.
因此,许多连续的训练实例来自相同的轨迹,而不是具有独立遮罩模式的多个数据样本。
每一步骤仍需要一次调试,可分批进行,并逐步平行解析(图2,左)。

blocks.en:
We use the top- u u policy ( Section 2 ), which matches the TinyGSM decoding policy: at each step, we reveal the u u most confident masked positions.
We use the MDM loss of Eq. 2.1 unchanged, including the 1 / t 1/t factor.
Here, t t is the realized masking ratio, so the loss is normalized by the number of masked tokens. Kim et al. (2026) show that, although PU sequences are not draws from the original noising process, this construction preserves the unique minimizer of the MDM objective.

blocks.en:
For stability, a trajectory advances by committing the ground-truth token (hence teacher-forced) at each selected position rather than using the predictions of the denoiser.
The mask pattern is therefore model-dependent, but the clean tokens are not.
Under the policies we consider, a committed position is never revisited, so a sampled token (student forcing; Bengio et al., 2015 ) would introduce an error that could not be corrected later.
The loss would still ask for the ground-truth 𝐱 0 \mathbf{x}_{0} at the remaining masked positions, so these targets could contradict the visible context.
We investigate student forcing and its failure cases in PU in Section C.3 .

blocks.en:
At small u u , the targeted inference regime, PU breaks two assumptions of stochastic optimization: each sequence is reused J J times instead of once, and consecutive batches share all but a fraction 1 / J 1/J of their sequences instead of being independent.
To see how the model responds, we launch short TinyGSM training runs at fixed u u , where every trajectory lasts exactly J J steps ( Section D.1 ), and track the completion loss of held-out sequences as they enter and leave the batch, i.e. , the loss on the second half of the answer given the prompt and the first half.
We observe local overfitting ( Figure 2 , middle ): at u = 2 u{=}2 , the completion loss of a sequence falls sharply within about 50 50 steps of entering the batch, and even rises again before the sequence leaves it: the model soon fits the sequence on the masks of its trajectory, after which the sequence provides no gradient for its revealed tokens, which are forgotten ( Section D.3 ).
The drop shrinks as u u grows and, as expected, vanishes with MDM.
As in regular overfitting, the validation loss moves opposite to the training loss ( Figure 2 , right ); in these runs, PU trails MDM on validation completion loss for every u ≤ 8 u\leq 8 ( Table 9 ), so local overfitting prevents training PU at the small u u used at inference (see Appendix D for an in-depth study).

在小u u,即目标推论制度下,PU打破了两个结构优化的假设:每个序列被重用J J乘数而不是一次,连续批次除分数1/J 1/J外全部共享其序列而不是独立.
为了了解模型是如何反应的,我们发射短短的TinyGSM训练运行在固定的u u 上,每个轨迹都精确地持续J J步骤(D.1节),跟踪在进入和离开批次时被搁置的序列的完成损失,即由于即时和前半段,后半段的答案损失.

The original PUMA recipe does this by committing a random number of positions per step, which is annealed over training, and additionally committing every position whose confidence exceeds 0.9 0.9 ( Section B.2 ).
Its effective training u u , the number of generated positions divided by the number of forward passes per sequence, is about 133 133 at the start of training and 67 67 at the end, against u = 2 u{=}2 at inference.

blocks.en: 3.2 Propagating Information Across Denoising Steps
blocks.zh: 3.2 宣传跨脱欧步骤的信息

blocks.en:
In PU, each step influences the input seen by the next step, but the objective trains each step only to make its own predictions, while the next step receives only the committed tokens.
We argue that a denoising step should not only predict its own tokens, but also produce an output that enables subsequent steps to operate effectively, especially since committed positions are never revisited.
Training for this requires a channel that passes information from one step to the next, and a gradient that flows back through it.
The channel can be a continuous carry that bypasses the discrete commitment ( Jo et al., 2026 ; Hu et al., 2026 ) , or a gradient estimator through the committed tokens themselves, which we call a discrete bridge ( Jang et al., 2017 ; Maddison et al., 2017 ; Bengio et al., 2013 ; Williams, 1992 ) .
We first describe the carry and how we train it, then compare it with the discrete bridges.
blocks.zh:
在PU中,每一步都会影响下一步看到的输入,但目标列车每一步只为作出自己的预测,而下一步只接收承诺的符号.
我们主张,一个虚张声势的步骤不仅应预测自己的征兆,而且还应产生一项产出,使随后的步骤能够有效运作,特别是因为承诺的立场从未得到重新考虑。
这方面的培训需要一个从一步到另一步传递信息的渠道,以及一个回流的梯度。
该通道可以是绕过离散承诺(Jo et al.,2026;Hu et al.,2026)的连续载体,也可以是通过承诺的标志本身的梯度估计器,我们称之为离散桥(Jang et al.,2017;Maddison et al.,2017;Bengio et al.,2013;Williams,1992).
我们首先描述载荷和如何训练,然后与离散的桥梁进行比较.

blocks.en:
The carry can be the hidden state of the denoiser ( Jo et al., 2026 ) or the probability-weighted input embedding of each prediction ( Hu et al., 2026 ) .
We adopt the carry design from loopholing ( Jo et al., 2026 ) for its simplicity and compactness, and do not ablate other designs.
The denoiser thus also takes the previous hidden state as input and returns its own: ( f θ ( ⋅ ∣ 𝐱 t j , h j ) , h j + 1 ) = f carry ( 𝐱 t j , h j ) . \bigl(f_{\theta}(\cdot\mid\mathbf{x}_{t_{j}},h_{j}),\ h_{j+1}\bigr)=f_{\mathrm{carry}}(\mathbf{x}_{t_{j}},h_{j}). (3.1) The carry h j ∈ ℝ L × d h_{j}\in\mathbb{R}^{L\times d} is the last hidden state before the output projection, one vector of width d ≪ | 𝒱 | d\ll|\mathcal{V}| per position ( Appendix B ).
Each trajectory starts from a zero carry, and each inference step passes its carry to the next.
The carry thus provides a weak form of student forcing: it is produced by the model at the previous step and reflects its imperfect predictions, while the visible tokens, and hence the targets, stay consistent with 𝐱 0 \mathbf{x}_{0} .

我们采用循环设计(Jo et al., 2026年),因为它简单而紧凑,而不放弃其他设计。

blocks.en:
When each update trains on a single step ( W = 1 W{=}1 ), the model learns to use the carry it receives but not to produce a useful one, since no term of the objective depends on the carry’s effect on the next step.
We therefore compute the loss on W W consecutive steps of the same trajectory in one update and backpropagate through the carries between them.
The loss at each step then reaches the preceding steps of the window, so the carry is also optimized for the predictions that follow.
As a trajectory usually exceeds W W steps, we split it into consecutive windows, each with its own update, and gradients do not cross between windows.
The resulting procedure ( Algorithm 1 ) is truncated backpropagation through time (BPTT).
blocks.zh:
当每对单步(W=1 W{=}1)的列车进行更新时,车型会学会使用它接收的载荷,但不会产生有用的载荷,因为目标的任何术语都不得取决于载荷对下一步的影响.
因此,我们在一次更新中计算WW连续轨迹的损失,并通过它们之间的承载进行后支撑。
每一步的损失然后到达窗口的前面的阶梯,因此对之后的预测也优化了承载.
由于轨迹通常超过W W 级,我们把它分成连续的窗口,每个窗口都有自己的更新,梯度不会在窗口之间交叉.
由此产生的程序(agorithm 1 )是经过时间(BPTT)缩短的反向传播。

blocks.en:
To compare the carry with the discrete bridges, we fix the window at W = 2 W{=}2 and replace the carry with a relaxed categorical (Gumbel-softmax) ( Jang et al., 2017 ; Maddison et al., 2017 ) , a straight-through estimator ( Bengio et al., 2013 ) , and a score-function (REINFORCE) estimator ( Williams, 1992 ) with a leave-one-out baseline ( Kool et al., 2019 ) .
To remove confounders and keep the training distribution stationary, all runs of this comparison keep the PUMA recipe at its initial setting instead of annealing it, under the same budget.
blocks.zh:
为了与离散桥进行比较,我们将窗口固定在W = 2 W{=}2,并更换为宽松的直截了当(Gumbel-softmax)(Jang等人,2017年;Maddison等人,2017年),直通估计器(Bengio等人,2013年),以及记分功能(REINFORCE)估计器(Williams,1992年),以一个离场基线(Kool等人,2019年)取代了承载.
为了清除困惑者并保持培训分配的固定状态,所有这种比较都使PUMA配方在最初设定时保持不变,而不是在同一个预算下予以抵消。

blocks.en: The carry outperforms all discrete bridges ( Table 1 ; training curves in Section C.2 ), so we adopt it as the default strategy.
blocks.zh: 执行效果超过了所有离散桥梁(表1;C.2节中的训练曲线),所以我们把它作为默认策略.

blocks.en:
The carry passes through a zero-initialized LayerNorm ( Ba et al., 2016 ) and is added to the token embeddings, so training starts from the unmodified denoiser.
MDM training has no predecessor to take a carry from, so loopholing obtains one by self-conditioning ( Chen et al., 2023 ; Jabri et al., 2023 ) , with an extra forward pass that adds about 30 % 30\% training time ( Jo et al., 2026 ) .
Under PU, the predecessor exists, so we simply cache its carry, one L × d L\times d tensor per trajectory.
Each update averages the losses of its window, so compute and memory grow linearly in W W while the update scale does not. Algorithm 1 in Section B.1 summarizes the resulting algorithm, PUMBA.

搭载通过一个零初始化的LayerNorm(Ba等人,2016年),并添加到符号嵌入器中,因此训练从未修改的denoiser开始.
MDM训练没有前身可以从中抽身,因此Robelholing通过自理获得一个(Chen等人,2023年;Jabri等人,2023年),附加前传,增加了约30%的30QQ训练时间(Jo等人,2026年).
在PU下,前身存在,所以我们只是缓存其载荷,每个轨迹1L × d L\times d lotor.
每一次更新平均其窗口的损失,因此计算和内存在WW中线性增长,而更新的尺度则没有. B.1节中的算法1概括了由此产生的算法,PUMBA.

blocks.en:
The first part of Proposition 1 explains why discrete gradient estimators do not match the carry ( Table 1 ), while the second part shows that the gap to the best achievable sampler shrinks as the window grows, and vanishes when the window covers the whole trajectory.
If the carry-augmented sampler can approximate p ⋆ p^{\star} arbitrarily well, a large enough window then yields a sampler closer to p ⋆ p^{\star} than any AR model with nonzero error ( Corollary 1 ).
Part (i) holds along any teacher-forced trajectory; part (ii) holds when training and inference share the reveal rule, and Figure 3 and Table 2 test empirically whether its prediction carries over to the smaller inference u u .
We discuss the scope of the bound in more detail in Appendix E .
blocks.zh:
提议1的第一部分解释了离散梯度估计器为何与载体不匹配(表1),第二部分则显示,随着窗口的增大,与最佳可实现采样器的差距缩小,当窗口覆盖整个轨迹时消失.
如果带宽的采样器可以任意地大致表示p ⋆ p^{\star},那么一个足够大的窗口就会产生一个更接近p ⋆ p^{\star}的采样器,而不是任何有非零错误的AR模型(Corollary 1 ).

blocks.en: 3.3 Composing the Design Choices
blocks.zh: 3.3 设计选择

blocks.en: Table 2 : Best GSM8K accuracy (%) at u = 2 u{=}2 ; MDM and PU: mean ± \pm s.d. over three seeds.
blocks.zh: 表2:在u = 2 u{=}2时最佳GSM8K精度(%); MDM 和 PU: 平均值 ±\pm s.d.

blocks.en:
We now combine the choices of Sections 3.1 and 3.2 and compare them with MDM and AR baselines.
To increase alignment, we train a standard MDM, PU, PU with the carry ( W = 1 W{=}1 ), and PU with the carry trained by BPTT over W ∈ { 2 , 4 , 8 } W\in\{2,4,8\} steps.
As controls, we train MDM for 2 × 2\times and 8 × 8\times as many epochs, which matches the number of denoiser forward and backward passes of BPTT at W = 2 W{=}2 and W = 8 W{=}8 , since each BPTT update runs W W of them.
We also train an AR model of the same size on the same data.
blocks.zh:
我们现在把第3.1节和第3.2节的选择合并起来,并与管理和管理部及年度报告基线进行比较。
为了增强对齐性,我们训练一个标准的MDM,PU,PU搭载(W=1W{=}1),PU搭载由BPTT训练的搭载在W {{{{2,4,8}W\in\{2,4,8\}步.
作为控制器,我们训练MDM2×2\times和8×8xtimes的时段数是多个时段,这与BPTT在W=2W{=}2和W=8W{=}8的前向和后向通过次数相匹配,因为BPTT每次更新都会运行其中的WW.
我们也在同一个数据上训练一个大小相同的AR模型.

blocks.en:
The three design choices compose: each one adds accuracy on top of the previous ones, at u = 2 u{=}2 ( Table 2 ) and at every other decoding budget we evaluate ( Figure 7 ).
At a matched number of denoiser passes, MDM trained 2 × 2\times or 8 × 8\times longer remains substantially below the corresponding BPTT at W = 2 W{=}2 and W = 8 W{=}8 , respectively.
Accuracy also keeps increasing with the window, as Proposition 1 predicts.
Together, the three choices reach the best AR checkpoint while revealing more than one token per step.
Accuracy during training and pass@ k k are in Appendix C .
blocks.zh:
三种设计选择组成:每一种在前一种选择之上增加精度,在u = 2 u {=}2(表2)和我们评价的所有其他解码预算(图7).
在相应数量的Denoiser通行证上,经过培训的MDM2×2×8次或更长的8×8次仍然大大低于相应的BPTT,分别为W=2W{=}2和W=8W{=}8.
准确性也随着窗口不断提高,如建议1预测的那样.
这三个选择一起到达最佳AR检查点,同时每步揭示一个以上的符号.

blocks.en: 4 A PUMBA Recipe for Large-Scale SFT
blocks.zh: 大型SFT的PUMBA食谱

blocks.en: Following Section 3 , our SFT recipe for LLaDA-8B-Base ( Nie et al., 2025 ) trains on inference-policy trajectories at a larger u u than at inference, avoiding local overfitting while keeping training masks aligned, and trains the carry by BPTT over a window W W .
blocks.zh: 继第3节之后,我们的LLaDA-8B-Base(Nie等人,2025年)的SFT配方在比推论更大的uu上进行推论政策轨迹培训,避免在保持训练口罩对齐的同时进行局部过度调整,并在窗口WW上对BPTT的载体进行培训。

blocks.en:
TinyGSM samples have similar lengths, so the PUMA recipe, which reveals a fixed length fraction per step, unmasks a similar number of tokens for all of them.
SFT responses instead range from 14 tokens at the 10th percentile to 778 at the 90th ( Section B.2 ). We fix the minimum number of tokens per step: every trajectory starts fully masked, and each step reveals the u u most confident positions, plus every other position with confidence above τ = 0.9 \tau{=}0.9 .
blocks.zh:
TinyGSM样本有相似的长度,所以PUMA配方,每步揭示一个固定的长度分数,解析出所有标记的类似数量.
反之,SFT的答复范围从10百分位的14个令牌到90位的778个令牌(B.2节)。 我们每一步固定最小的符号数:每个轨迹开始完全蒙蔽,每个步骤都揭示出uu最自信的位置,加上信心在\\\\\\\\\=0.9以上的其他位置.

blocks.en:
To separate the effect due to PUMBA from the model simply learning the data distribution, we use two stages: standard SFT of LLaDA-8B-Base, during which the model captures most of the target distribution, followed by a Post-SFT stage where we apply PUMBA with different parameters and the corresponding baselines. Since the original LLaDA SFT dataset is not publicly available, we use the SFT dataset from the OLMo 3 post-training pipeline ( Olmo Team, 2025 ) . We follow typical SFT practice: the prompt is fully revealed and only the response is maskable ( Nie et al., 2025 ; Ye et al., 2025 ) .
Additional details are present in Appendix B .
blocks.zh:
为了将由于PUMBA的影响与模型仅仅学习数据分布,我们使用两个阶段:标准SFT的LLaDA-8B-Base,其间模型捕捉了大部分的目标分布,然后是SFT后阶段,我们应用了具有不同参数和相应基线的PUMBA. 由于最初的LLaDA SFT数据集不公开,我们使用OLMo 3训练后管道的SFT数据集(Olmo Team,2025年). 我们遵循典型的SFT做法:充分揭示了迅速性,只有反应是可掩盖的(Nie等人,2025年;Ye等人,2025年)。
详情见附录B。

blocks.en:
We evaluate along two axes: the model’s learned ability to follow instructions, and potential regression on other capabilities.
For instruction following, we use IFEval ( Zhou et al., 2023 ) , which measures the central capability targeted by our general SFT. To check that other capabilities are preserved, we additionally evaluate on GSM8K ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) (math) and MBPP ( Austin et al., 2021b ) (code).
We refer to the mean of the three benchmarks as the score .
We decode with Fast-dLLM ( Wu et al., 2026b ) in blocks of size 32 and report each model’s score–NFE curve over its threshold τ ∈ { 0.7 , 0.8 , 0.9 , 1 } \tau\in\{0.7,0.8,0.9,1\} , from one token per step ( τ = 1 \tau{=}1 ) to more in parallel.
We consider two settings: full-canvas and block diffusion .
blocks.zh:
我们沿着两个轴心来评估:模型遵循指示的学习能力,以及其他能力的潜在倒退。
我们使用IFEval(周等人,2023年)来测量我们通用的SFT瞄准的中心能力。 为了检查其他能力是否得到保存,我们额外评价了GSM8K(Cobbe等人,2021年)(math)和MBPP(Austin等人,2021年b)(代码).
我们把三个基准的平均值称为得分。
我们用快速dLLM(Wu et al., 2026b)解码为32码的区块,并报告每个模型的得分-NFE曲线超过它的阈值 {{ 0.7, 0.8, 0. 9, 1}\ tau\ in 0, 0. 0. 8, 0.9, 1\}, 从每步一个符(\ = 1\ tau\ 1)到更多平行.
我们考虑两种设置:全面扫描和块状扩散。

blocks.en: 4.1 Full-Canvas Generation
blocks.zh: 4.1 全面加拿大裔

blocks.en:
In the full-canvas setting, the model attends to the full sequence bidirectionally.
We SFT the model with the vanilla MDM objective for 1.5 epochs ( ≈ \approx 25k training steps) at a global batch size of 128 sequences, over which the model sees 2.71 B tokens.
From this checkpoint, we enter the Post-SFT stage and train for an additional 4000 steps.
We compare PU and PU with the carry trained by BPTT over a window W W , where W = 1 W{=}1 passes the carry without gradient, and sweep the training u u and W W .
As baselines, we continue the 1.5-epoch checkpoint with MDM for the same 4000 steps (Post-SFT MDM), which rules out gains from the additional updates alone, and double the SFT budget to 3 epochs, which shows that MDM training has nearly saturated on this data.
We report results for u ∈ { 32 , 64 } u\in\{32,64\} with remaining values present in Appendix F .
blocks.zh:
在全扫描布局中,模型双向处理全序列.
我们SFT以香草MDM目标为1.5个纪元的模型(QQ\\\ 大约25k训练步骤),全球批量大小为128个序列,模型上看到2.71B符.
从这个检查站,我们进入SFT后舞台,再训练4000步.
我们把PU和PU与BPTT训练的载具比作一个窗口W W,其中W=1WQQ1通过载具而无梯度,并扫射训练u u和W W W.
作为基线,我们用MDM(后SFT MDM)继续使用1.5个时段的检查点,用于相同的4000步(后SFT MDM),这排除了仅从额外更新中获得的收益,将SFT的预算翻一番到3个时段,这表明MDM培训在这些数据上几乎饱和.
我们报告u { { 32, 64} u\ in { 32, 64} 的结果,附录F中的剩余数值。

blocks.en:
Figure 4 : Post-SFT of LLaDA-8B for full canvas ( top row ) and block diffusion ( bottom row ).
In each legend, we set in bold the SFT checkpoint the Post-SFT runs of that setting start from.
blocks.zh:
图4:用于全画布(上行)和块扩散(下行)的LLaDA-8BSFT后.

blocks.en:
Neither baseline improves much: Post-SFT MDM stays close to its starting checkpoint, and the 3-epoch SFT, despite twice the training, improves only slightly and only at higher NFEs, suggesting that MDM training has nearly saturated on this data.
In contrast, PUMBA improves the score while reducing NFEs, with a fraction of the SFT step budget.
Its best configuration ( u = 32 u{=}32 , W = 8 W{=}8 ) gains 2.6 2.6 points, over three times the gain of doubling the SFT budget, and at matched score PUMBA needs up to 22 % 22\% fewer NFEs than the 3-epoch SFT ( Figure 4 ).
blocks.zh:
基线都没有大改进:SFT后 MDM保持靠近其起始检查站,3世纪SFT尽管训练了两倍,但只稍有改进,只在较高的NFE上有所改进,说明MDM训练在这个数据上几乎饱和.
相比之下,PUMBA则在降低NFE的同时提高分数,并有一小部分SFT步预算.
其最佳配置(u = 32 u {=}32,W = 8 W{=}8)获得2.6分,超过SFT预算翻一番的三倍,在相应的分数上,PUMBA需要的NFE比3-epoc SFT少22% 22\%(图4).

blocks.en: 4.2 Block Diffusion
blocks.zh: 4.2 块扩散

blocks.en:
In the block diffusion setting, the model generates the response block by block, attending block-causally to previous blocks and bidirectionally within the current one.
This attention pattern departs from LLaDA’s fully bidirectional pre-training, and we find that it requires a longer SFT to reach competitive performance.
We therefore run SFT for 6 epochs, using the vectorized implementation of Arriola et al. (2025) , which trains all blocks of a sequence in a single forward pass, with blocks of size 32 to match the Fast-dLLM inference policy ( Wu et al., 2026b ) .
blocks.zh:
在块扩散设定中,该模型逐块生成反应块,在前几个块中按块生成反应块,并在当前一个块内双向生成反应块.
这种关注模式不同于LLaDA完全双向的预训,我们发现需要更长的SFT才能达到竞争性的性能.
因此,我们利用Arriola等人(2025年)的矢量化实施,运行了6个纪元的SFT,它用一个单一的前进通道来训练所有顺序的区块,有32个大小的区块来配合Fast-dLLM推论政策(Wu等人,2026年b).

blocks.en:
Post-SFT starts from this checkpoint and, as in the full-canvas setting, runs for 4000 steps for each composition of PU and BPTT.
In the full-canvas setup, the reference for longer MDM training was a run with twice the SFT budget, which here would require 12 epochs.
We instead use the 3-epoch checkpoint of the same run, so that the step from 3 to 6 epochs measures what doubling SFT yields.
Since blocks have a fixed size of 32, u u fixes the number of steps per block, which upper-bounds the window: e.g., u = 16 u{=}16 implies W ≤ 2 W\leq 2 .
We report results for u ∈ { 8 , 16 } u\in\{8,16\} in Figure 4 ; the remaining values are in Appendix F .
Consistent with the full-canvas setting, PUMBA improves over the MDM baselines.
PU alone and the carry ( W = 1 W{=}1 ) bring modest gains, but BPTT with wider windows yields a clear improvement.
The best configuration in Figure 4 ( u = 16 u{=}16 , W = 2 W{=}2 ) gains 2.2 2.2 points in 4000 steps, more than the 50k SFT steps from 3 to 6 epochs, and at matched score it needs 26 % 26\% fewer NFEs than the Post-SFT MDM control.
The PUMBA variants also consistently reduce NFEs, a trend not observed with progressively longer SFT (see Table 12 for best scores per variant).
blocks.zh:
SFT后从这个检查站开始,如同在全扫描布局中一样,PU和BPTT的每个组成都运行4000步.
在全扫描布局中,较长的MDM训练的参照标准是使用SFT预算的两倍,这里需要12个世纪.
相反,我们使用同一跑道的3个时段检查站,这样,从3个时段到6个时段的步骤就可以衡量SFT产量翻一番的情况。
由于区块的固定大小为32 u u 确定每个区块的步数,这些步数上行 窗口 : 例如, u = 16 u = 16 意味着 W≤ 2 W\leq 2 .
我们在图4中报告 u {{8, 16}\\\\\\的 u\\\\ 8,16}的结果;其余的数值见附录F。
与全扫描布局一致,PUMBA比MDM基线有所改善.
单PU和载荷(W=1 W{=}1)能带来微小的增益,但具有较宽窗口的BPTT能产生明显的改善.
图4中的最佳配置(u = 16 u{=}16,W = 2 W{=}2)在4000步中获得2.2分,超过3至6个纪元的50k SFT步数,在对应的分数下需要比SFT MDM后控制少26%的26\%.
PUMBA变种也持续减少NFE,这一趋势在SFT逐渐延长后没有观察到(每个变种的最佳分数见表12).

blocks.en: 4.3 Failure Modes at Small Training u u
blocks.zh: 4.3 小型培训的失败模式

blocks.en:
Random masking acts as implicit data augmentation, which favors MDM over AR models when data is repeated ( Prabhudesai et al., 2025 ) . However, these masks are drawn independently of the unmasking policy, so most orderings seen in training never occur at inference. PU concentrates training on the orderings the inference policy produces, yielding a more targeted and data-efficient signal. At moderate u u and matched compute, PU-based variants tend to outperform the MDM baselines. This advantage, however, holds only while u u is large enough: the smaller u u , the longer each trajectory, and the fewer distinct samples the model sees in a fixed number of steps. Figure 5 measures this cost directly: at full-canvas u = 1 u{=}1 a run sees only 0.6 % 0.6\% of samples visited by MDM, rising to 26 % 26\% at u = 128 u{=}128 . Block diffusion is less exposed, reaching 100 % 100\% by u = 32 u{=}32 , since the parallel-block implementation stratifies unmasking: u = 1 u{=}1 reveals one token per block rather than one in the entire sequence. As u u decreases, fewer distinct samples are seen and each stays longer in the batch ( Figure 25 ), until the model overfits locally and training collapses ( Figure 5 ). At the other extreme, PU at u = 128 u{=}128 only matches the Post-SFT MDM control: each step reveals a large part of the response, so the trajectory reduces to a few coarse steps.
The best training u u needs to be small enough to align with inference and large enough to allow the model to learn.
blocks.zh:
随机遮盖起到暗含数据增强的作用,在重复数据时,MDM优于AR模型(Prabhudesai等人,2025年)。 然而,这些面具是独立于脱口秀政策抽取的,因此在训练中见到的大多数订单从来就没有过推断. PU集中培训定购推论政策产生的订单,产生更有针对性和数据效率更高的信号. 在中度u u和匹配计算时,基于PU的变体往往比MDM的基线要好. 然而,这一优势只在u u 足够大的时候才存在: 越小的u u ,每个轨迹越长,模型在固定的步数中看到的不同的样本越少. 图5直接测量了这一成本:在全扫描仪u=1u{=}1时,MDM访问的样本中只有0.6%.6%.6%.,在u=128u{=}128时上升到26%.26.%. 块扩散率较低, 以 u = 32 u = 32 = o = 32 = 达到 100% 的 100 \%, 因为平行块执行会分解: u = 1 u = 1 u = 1 显示每个块的一个符号, 而不是整个序列中的一个符号 。 随着u u 的减少,可见的明显样本较少,每个样本在批量中停留的时间更长(图25),直到模型在本地和培训上超标(图5)。 在另一个极端,U = 128 u = 128的PU只匹配SFT MDM后控制:每一步都揭示了大部分响应,因此轨迹缩小为几步粗细.
最好的训练uu需要小到足够与推论一致,并且大到足够让模型学习.

blocks.en: 5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en:
Diffusion language models operate on continuous representations ( Li et al., 2022 ; Dieleman et al., 2022 ) or discrete tokens ( Hoogeboom et al., 2021 ; Austin et al., 2021a ; Campbell et al., 2022 ; Lou et al., 2024 ) .
Masked diffusion simplifies the absorbing-state formulation ( Shi et al., 2024 ; Sahoo et al., 2024 ) and scales to large language models through autoregressive conversion or training from scratch ( Gong et al., 2025 ; Ye et al., 2025 ; Nie et al., 2025 ) .
Block Diffusion is a particularly effective diffusion formulation for language modeling, combining autoregressive generation across blocks with parallel denoising within them ( Arriola et al., 2025 ) .
We study how to post-train these models for the states their decoders induce.
blocks.zh:
传播语言模式在连续表达上运作 (Li等人, 2022年;Dieleman等人, 2022年)或离散标志(Hoogeboom等人, 2021年;Austin等人, 2021年a;Campbell等人, 2022年;Lou等人, 2024年).
蒙面扩散简化了吸收态配体(Shi等人,2024年;Sahoo等人,2024年),并通过自旋转换或从零开始的训练,将吸收态配体放大为大语言模型(Gong等人,2025年;Ye等人,2025年;Nie等人,2025年)。
块扩散是语言模型化的一种特别有效的传播配体,将自递性生成跨块与它们内部的平行去诺化相结合(Arriola等人,2025年)。
我们研究如何在训练这些模型后 为这些状态,他们的解码器诱导。

blocks.en:
MDM inference policies choose both the reveal order and the degree of parallelism.
Common criteria include confidence ( Ghazvininejad et al., 2019 ; Chang et al., 2022 ; Wu et al., 2026b ) , probability margins ( Kim et al., 2025 ) , and predictive entropy ( Ben-Hamu et al., 2025 ) ; others use explicit planners ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Peng et al., 2025 ) or learned unmasking policies ( Jazbec et al., 2026 ) .
These policies induce structured trajectories whose intermediate states differ from the random corruptions used in conventional training, motivating our focus on trajectory alignment.
blocks.zh:
MDM推论政策既选择显示顺序,又选择平行程度.
共同标准包括信心(Ghazvininejad等人,2001年)。 2019; Chang等人, 2022; Wu等人, 2026b),概率差(Kim等人, 2025),和预测性肽(Ben-Hamu等人, 2025);其他人使用明确的规划者. (Liu等人,2025年;Peng等人,2025年)或学会了揭开面具的政策(Jazbec等人,2026年).
这些政策诱导了结构化的轨迹,其中间状态不同于常规训练中使用的随机腐败,促使我们注重轨迹调整。

blocks.en:
Training on expert states while generating from model predictions is a longstanding challenge ( Ross et al., 2011 ; Bengio et al., 2015 ) ; in MDMs, the shift concerns both revealed positions and token content.
PUMA trains on progressive teacher-forced unmasking trajectories ( Kim et al., 2026 ) , while PAPL reweights the loss for the decoding planner ( Peng et al., 2026 ) .
Other approaches leverage task rewards along denoising trajectories ( He et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) or supervise model-induced states through on-policy distillation ( Ren et al., 2026 ; Su et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026 ) .
Relatedly, SDTT distills many-step denoising into fewer sampling steps ( Deschenaux & Gulcehre, 2025 ) .
We investigate alignment directly within supervised instruction fine-tuning, without task-specific reward optimization or distillation.
blocks.zh:
从模型预测中生成专家状态的培训是一项长期挑战(Ross等人,2011年;Bengio等人,2015年);在多边气候模型中,转变既涉及立场,也涉及象征性内容。
PUMA列车采用渐进式教师强制脱假轨距(Kim等人,2026年),而PAPL则对解码计划员的损失进行重估(Peng等人,2026年).
其他办法利用任务奖励,沿脱钩轨迹(He等人,2025年;Wang等人,2026年)或通过政策蒸馏监督模型引起的国家(Ren等人,2026年;Su等人,2026年;Xu等人,2026年)。
与此相关的是,SDTT将许多步骤去诺化为较少的采样步骤(Dechenaux & Gulcehre, 2025).
我们直接在监督指令中调查调整情况,没有针对具体任务的奖励优化或提炼。

blocks.en:
Loopholing preserves latent information through self-conditioning ( Jo et al., 2026 ) .
RCD and DiffusionGemma instead feed back the probability-weighted input embedding of each prediction ( Hu et al., 2026 ; DiffusionGemma Team, 2026 ) .
MetaState adds persistent working memory to a frozen backbone ( Xia et al., 2026 ) .
Closely related to PUMBA, Relay passes differentiable per-token representations between steps and trains them with truncated BPTT ( Rozonoyer et al., 2026 ) , but uses a two-step unroll ( W = 2 W{=}2 in our notation) in all its experiments.
Our study combines trajectory-aligned supervised post-training with continuous state propagation, examines each component’s contribution, and characterizes the trade-off between alignment and learnability. Appendix G details the comparison with the closest work.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We improve masked diffusion training by aligning it with the trajectories encountered during generation. Building on progressive unmasking methods, we cache the denoiser’s hidden state across steps and use truncated BPTT to train each step for its contribution to subsequent predictions. We study the components of the resulting method, PUMBA, on TinyGSM and show we can scale PUMBA to general-purpose instruction-following SFT on LLaDA-8B, improving the performance–NFE frontier under both full-canvas and block diffusion. In particular, the Post-SFT recipe we employ is practical: it pushes a model beyond what additional SFT allows, and the resulting reduction in denoising steps amortizes this extra training stage, which is short, since a small number of training steps suffices to realize the gains of PUMBA. Our findings highlight the need to balance trajectory alignment with the diversity required for effective learning.
blocks.zh: 我们改进了蒙面传播培训,使其与一代人遇到的轨迹相一致。 在渐进式的解密方法的基础上,我们缓存了Denoiser的隐藏状态跨步骤,并使用截断的BPTT来训练每一步,以示其对后续预测的贡献。 我们在TinyGSM上研究了产生的方法PUMBA的组件,并显示我们可以在LLaDA-8B上将PUMBA扩大为通用的跟随SFT的SFT,在全扫描和块传播下改进性能-NFE前沿. 特别是,我们使用的SFT后配方是实用的:它推动的模式超出了SFT的附加允许范围,由此导致的去名化步骤的减少使这个额外的培训阶段分期偿还,这个阶段很短,因为少量的培训步骤足以实现PUMBA的成果. 我们的调查结果强调,必须平衡轨迹与有效学习所需的多样性。

blocks.en: We identify local overfitting at small reveal counts, caused by reusing each training sequence over many consecutive steps, and ways to mitigate it; turning these findings into training procedures that sustain closer inference alignment across model scales, and across decoding policies beyond the confidence-based ones we study, remains open. Extending the carry’s weak student forcing to sampled tokens did not improve on teacher forcing in preliminary experiments ( Section C.3 ), since irreversible wrong commitments leave the context inconsistent with the target; remasking could address this. Finally, we use a minimal carry to isolate the benefits of trajectory alignment and BPTT; richer carries, such as the fixed-size working memory of MetaState ( Xia et al., 2026 ) , and BPTT-specific gradient checkpointing, selective gradient propagation, or adaptive windows could improve the trade-off between training cost, memory, and credit-assignment horizon.
blocks.zh: 我们发现,由于在连续许多步骤中重新使用每个培训序列,我们发现地方在微小的显示点上的调整过大,以及减轻这种调整的方法;将这些结果转化为培训程序,使模型尺度之间以及我们研究的基于信任的政策之外,维持更紧密的推论调整。 在初步实验中,由于无法逆转的错误承诺使得背景与目标不一致,强迫学生抽取代币的薄弱程度并没有改善教师的强迫性(C.3节),重新装模作样可以解决这个问题。 最后,我们用一个最小的载荷来隔离轨迹调整和BPTT的好处;更丰富的载荷,如MetaState的固定尺寸的工作记忆(Xia等人,2026年),以及BPTT特有的梯度检查,选择性的梯度传播,或适应性窗口可以改善培训成本,内存和信用分配视野之间的权衡.

Masked diffusion defines a generative model over sequences through a forward process that masks tokens and a backward process that unmasks them.
The forward, or noising , process is a family of corruptions indexed by a level t ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] t\in[0,1] that interpolates between a clean sequence 𝐱 0 ∈ 𝒱 L \mathbf{x}_{0}\in\mathcal{V}^{L} at t = 0 t=0 and the fully masked sequence ( m , … , m ) (m,\ldots,m) at t = 1 t=1 .
It factorizes over positions, with q ⁡ ( x t i ∣ x 0 i ) = Cat ⁡ ( α t ​ 𝐞 x 0 i + ( 1 − α t ) ​ 𝐞 m ) q(x_{t}^{i}\mid x_{0}^{i})=\mathrm{Cat}\bigl(\alpha_{t}\mathbf{e}_{x_{0}^{i}}+(1-\alpha_{t})\,\mathbf{e}_{m}\bigr) , so that x 0 i x_{0}^{i} is retained with probability α t \alpha_{t} and replaced by m m otherwise.
The coefficient α t \alpha_{t} decreases monotonically from α 0 = 1 \alpha_{0}=1 to α 1 = 0 \alpha_{1}=0 , and a common choice is the linear schedule α t = 1 − t \alpha_{t}=1-t ( Sahoo et al., 2024 ; Shi et al., 2024 ) .
The backward, or denoising , process runs from t = 1 t=1 to t = 0 t=0 and fills in the masked positions.
Its transitions are defined by the posterior q ⁡ ( x 0 i ∣ 𝐱 t ) q(x_{0}^{i}\mid\mathbf{x}_{t}) over the clean token at a masked position, which depends on the unknown data distribution and is intractable.
Masked diffusion models approximate this posterior with a learned denoiser and generate data by iterating the resulting transitions from the fully masked sequence.

Since the 1 / t 1/t factor of Eq. 2.1 normalizes each step’s loss per masked token, all steps of a window contribute equally regardless of their masking ratio.
blocks.zh:
每个窗口的损失均按其台阶平均计算,这使得更新尺度独立于WW.
由于Eq.2.1的1/t1/t系数使每个步骤的每件遮盖符件的损失正常化,所以窗口的所有步骤,不论其遮盖比例如何,都同等贡献。

blocks.en: B.2 Progressive unmasking: the two constructions
blocks.zh: B.2 逐步解密:两种构想

blocks.en:
The LLaDA-8B runs ( Section 4 ) use the confidence-threshold construction: each step commits every masked position whose confidence exceeds τ \tau , and at least u u positions.
The TinyGSM runs ( Section 3 ) instead follow the construction of Kim et al. (2026) as published. Table 3 compares the two, and the paragraphs below give the details.
In both, confidence is the maximum probability over the vocabulary, computed in fp32 from the forward pass that produces the loss, and committed positions receive the ground-truth token.
blocks.zh:
LLaDA-8B运行 (第4节) 使用置信阈值构造:每一步都包含每个置信度超过\tau的遮蔽位置,以及至少u u 位置.
TinyGSM运行(第3节)转而沿用已公布的Kim等人(2026年)的构造. 表3比较了两者,下文各段提供了详细情况。
在这两种情况下,信任是词汇的最大概率,用Fp32从产生损失的前进通道中计算出来,而承诺的位置则得到地面真实信号。

blocks.en:
Table 3 : The two progressive unmasking constructions. L L is the number of maskable positions of a sample and K K the number of stages.
A trajectory is at stage p p when a fraction in [ p / K , ( p + 1 ) / K ) [p/K,(p+1)/K) of its L L positions is revealed.
blocks.zh:
表3:两种渐进式的无假构。 L L是样本的可遮掩位置数,K K是级数.
当其L L 位置的 [p/K, (p+1) / K] [p/K, (p+1)/K] 中的一小部分被揭示时,一个轨迹处于p 阶段.

blocks.en:
The K K stages split the revealed fraction of a trajectory into equal intervals: a trajectory is at stage p p when a fraction in [ p / K , ( p + 1 ) / K ) [p/K,(p+1)/K) of its maskable positions is revealed.
Each step nominally advances a trajectory by one stage, so a trajectory lasts about K K steps.
A new trajectory starts at stage 0 0 with a small fraction of its positions already revealed; these positions are drawn uniformly at random, not by confidence.
A step taken at stage p p samples a target fraction from the next interval and commits the most confident masked positions until that target is met.
The number of positions committed per step is therefore random, with mean close to L / K L/K .
The target is capped at L − 1 L-1 , so the reveal step alone never completes a trajectory.
Every other masked position with confidence above τ \tau is then committed as well, and the stage is recomputed from the revealed fraction.
A trajectory can therefore skip stages, although retirement is still decided by the stage before this recomputation.
The maskable region includes the EOS padding that fills the canvas to 512 tokens (the TinyGSM sequence length), so the padding counts toward L L and enters the loss.
In practice, the threshold commits most of the padding within about one step, so a trajectory lasts far fewer than K K steps: about 3.5 3.5 at K = 12 K=12 and 7 7 at K = 42 K=42 .
blocks.zh:
K K级将一个轨迹的显微分分割成等间隔:当其可遮掩位置的[p/K,(p+1)/K] [p/K,(p+1)/K]中的某一分数被揭示时,一个轨迹处于p级.
每一步在名义上都会推进一个阶段的轨迹,所以一个轨迹会持续到K K步.
一个新的轨迹从0级开始,其中一小部分位置已经暴露;这些位置是随机的,而不是通过信任来划出。
在p阶段采取的一个步骤是,从下一个间隔中抽取一个目标分数,并承担最自信的蒙面位置直至该目标实现。
因此,每一步承诺的职位数目是随机的,平均值接近L/KL/K。
目标封顶在L−1 L−1,因此单是揭示步骤就永远不会完成一个轨迹.
上面有自信的所有其他蒙面姿势,然后也是被承诺的,舞台由揭示的分数重算.
因此,轨迹可以跳过阶段,尽管退休在重新计算之前仍由阶段决定。
可遮掩区域包括将画布填充到512个令牌(TinyGSM序列长度)的EOS贴板,因此贴板算向LL并输入损失.
在实际操作中,阈值在大约一个步骤内承担大部分的粘贴,所以一个轨迹持续时间远小于K K步:在K = 12 K = 12,在K = 42 K = 42 = 7 个.

blocks.en:
Every trajectory starts fully masked, and there is no stage index and no schedule.
The prompt is always visible and never masked.
Each step commits the u u most confident masked positions, together with every other masked position whose confidence exceeds τ = 0.9 \tau=0.9 .
This is the same set as committing every position above τ \tau and topping up with the next most confident positions until at least u u are committed.
A trajectory is retired once its response and EOS are fully revealed, and a fresh, fully masked sample takes its place.
On the full canvas, padding inside the attended window is also maskable, so some of the u u positions committed at a step can be padding, which does not enter the loss.
blocks.zh:
每个轨迹都完全蒙蔽,没有舞台指数和时间表。
提示总是可见的,从不掩饰.
每一步骤都带有最自信的遮盖姿势,以及信心超过 \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\的所有其他遮盖姿势。
这与承诺在\ tau上方的每一个位置相同, 并填补下一个最自信的位置, 直到至少 u 被承诺为止。
一旦其反应和EOS完全暴露后,轨迹就会退役,一个新的,完全蒙蔽的样品就被取代.
在全画布上,被附设的窗口内部的粘贴也是可以遮掩的,因此在一步中承诺的一些u u 位置可以粘贴,不会进入损失.

blocks.en:
Progressive unmasking aims to train on the sequences that the inference policy visits ( Section 3.1 ).
The published construction approximates them with a schedule: a trajectory nominally lasts about K K steps, so each step commits about L / K L/K positions, whatever the length L L of the sample.
A confidence-threshold decoder instead commits a number of positions per step that does not depend on L L , so longer responses take more steps.
The two agree only when L L is nearly the same for every sample.
On TinyGSM, L L includes the EOS padding to 512 tokens and varies only with the prompt length, so we keep the published construction and its curriculum on K K , and our PU baseline is the recipe of Kim et al. (2026) .
On Dolci-Instruct-SFT, the response length ranges from 14 tokens at the 10th percentile to 778 at the 90th ( Figure 6 ).
At K = 42 K=42 , the final value of that curriculum, a 14-token response would receive about 0.3 0.3 commits per step, so most of its steps would commit nothing beyond the positions above τ \tau , while a 778-token response would receive about 18.5 18.5 commits per step.
No single K K therefore matches the decoding policy across the mixture.
Our construction drops the schedule and takes its reveal rule from the decoding policy itself: every trajectory starts fully masked, as decoding does, and each step commits by the same confidence-threshold rule, with τ \tau and u u as its only parameters.
It also removes the random reveal at stage 0 0 and the sampled commit count, which have no counterpart at inference.
blocks.zh:
逐步揭开面纱的目的是就推断政策访问的顺序进行培训(第3.1节)。
公布的构造与时间表相近:一个轨迹名义上持续着K K阶梯,所以每个阶梯都承诺了L/K L/K位置,无论样本的长度为L L.
置信阈值解码器每步会占用一些不依赖于LL的位置,因此较长的回复会采取更多步骤.
两人只在每份样本LL几乎相同时同意.
在TinyGSM上,LL包括了EOS贴到512令牌,并且只随快速长度而变化,因此我们把已公布的构造及其课程保留在K K上,我们的PU基线是Kim等人的配方(2026年).
在Dolci-Istruct-SFT上,反应长度从第10百分位的14个令牌到第90位的778个令牌(图6)不等.
在K = 42 K = 42 时,该课程的最终价值是,14个音符的答复每步将收到约0.3 0.3个音符,因此,其大多数步骤不会超过上述位置,而778个音符的答复每步将收到约18.5 18.5个音符的答复。
因此,没有单一的K K与混合物的解码政策相符。
我们的构造降低了时间表,并从解码政策本身中吸取了它的揭示规则:每个轨迹都像解码一样,开始完全蒙蔽,每个步骤都以相同的置信阈值规则来承担,以\tau和uu作为唯一的参数.
它还移除了0阶段的随机揭示和被抽样的承诺计数,没有对应的推论.

blocks.en: B.3 TinyGSM
blocks.zh: B.3 小型GSM

blocks.en: The TinyGSM experiments provide the controlled small-scale setting used to isolate the contribution of progressive unmasking, the on-trajectory hidden-state carry, and BPTT.
blocks.zh: TinyGSM实验提供了用于隔离进化脱假作用的受控小尺度设置,在轨隐藏状态载体,以及BPTT.

blocks.en:
We train on TinyGSM ( Liu et al., 2023 ) , holding out 2 % 2\% for validation, and evaluate on the 1,319 1{,}319 problems of the GSM8K test set ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) .
The prompt is always visible; only the response is masked and enters the loss, as typically adopted in the SFT settings ( Nie et al., 2025 ; Ye et al., 2025 ) .
Each TinyGSM response is a Python function, so we score a generation by executing the function it defines in a sandbox with a 1-second limit and comparing its return value with the GSM8K answer, exactly for integers and to within 10 − 3 10^{-3} for floats.
We report this accuracy with EMA weights.
Decoding is greedy and reveals the u u most confident masked positions at each step.
blocks.zh:
我们用TinyGSM(Liu等人,2023年)进行训练,持有2%的2+Q进行验证,并评价GSM8K测试集的1,319 1{,}319个问题(Cobbe等人,2021年).
提示总是可见的;只有反应被遮掩并进入损失,通常在SFT环境中采用(Nie等人,2025年;Ye等人,2025年)。
每个TinyGSM响应都是一种Python函数,所以我们通过执行它在1秒极限的沙盒中定义的函数来获得一代的分数,并将其返回值与GSM8K的答案进行比较,精确的表示整数,在10−3 10^{-3}范围内表示浮点数.
我们用EMA的权重来报告这个精度.
解密是贪婪的,并且揭示出你最自信的每个步骤的蒙面姿势.

blocks.en:
All diffusion variants share the architecture and start from random initialization.
For W > 1 W>1 , we lower the per-GPU batch size and accumulate gradients so that the effective batch stays at 256.
MDM × 2 \times 2 and × 8 \times 8 train for 40 and 160 epochs.
The AR model has the same size ( ≈ \approx 125M parameters), uses causal attention, and is trained with next-token cross-entropy on the same data, averaged over the response tokens up to and including the first EOS.
The denoiser, tokenizer, output parameterization, and loss shape are held fixed across the diffusion runs, whose loss also covers the EOS padding. Jo et al. (2026) propose carry dropout, which uses the carry only a fraction p p of the time during training and helps for p ∈ [ 0.5 , 0.9 ] p\in[0.5,0.9] in their experiments.
Our TinyGSM runs do not use it ( p = 1 p=1 ), so the carry is always passed on.
We also follow the curriculum on K K of Kim et al. (2026) : K K starts at 12 and rises by 3 every 30k updates from update 60k, reaching 42 at update 330k.
Each GPU keeps 32 trajectories, which start at stages spread evenly over { 0 , … , K − 1 } \{0,\dots,K-1\} .
Every change of K K re-initializes all trajectories this way, with a zero carry.
blocks.zh:
所有扩散变体共享架构,从随机初始化开始.
对于W > 1 W>1,我们降低每个GPU的批量大小并积累梯度,使有效批量保持在256.
MDM × 2 \ 2 × 8 \ 8  train 8  train 8  train 8  train 8  train 8  train  train  train s s s s  40  40  40  40 s s s s s s s
AR模型的大小相同(QQ\约125M参数),使用因果注意,并在相同数据上用次托肯横切来训练,平均在响应符上直到并包括第一个EOS.
电离层、信号器、输出参数化和损失形状被固定在扩散跑道上,其损失也包括EOS粘贴。 Jo等人(2026年)提议载运退学,这只使用训练期间时间p的一小部分载运,并在他们的实验中帮助p ∈ [0.5,0.9] p\in [0.5,0.9].
我们的小型GSM 运行不使用它(p = 1 p = 1),因此承载总是传递.
我们还遵循Kim等人的K K课程(2026年):K K开始于12,从更新60k起每30k更新增加3个,在更新330k时达到42个.
每个GPU保持32个轨迹,开始阶段均匀分布在 {0, ..., K − 1} {0,\ dots, K-1} 上.
KK的每次改变都会以这种方式重新初始化所有轨迹,零载荷.

blocks.en: Table 4 : Hyperparameters for the TinyGSM experiments.
blocks.zh: 表4:TinyGSM实验的超参数。

blocks.en: B.4 LLaDA-8B
blocks.zh: B.4 拉达-8B

blocks.en:
The LLaDA-8B experiments follow the two-stage procedure of Section 4 .
The SFT stage fine-tunes LLaDA-8B-Base ( Nie et al., 2025 ) with the MDM objective.
The Post-SFT stage continues from an SFT checkpoint with one of the compared training procedures. Table 5 lists the shared settings, Sections B.4.1 and B.4.2 those specific to each stage, and Section B.4.3 the evaluation.
blocks.zh:
LLaDA-8B实验遵循第4节的两阶段程序。
SFT阶段微调LLaDA-8B-Base(Nie等人,2025年),实现MDM目标.
SFT后阶段继续从SFT检查站开始,并有比较培训程序之一。 表5列出了共享的设置,B.4.1和B.4.2节列出了每个阶段的具体设置,B.4.3节列出了评价。

blocks.en:
Both stages train on Dolci-Instruct-SFT from the OLMo 3 post-training pipeline ( Olmo Team, 2025 ) .
The mixture contains instruction-following, mathematical, code, conversational, and tool-use examples.
We use the full mixture, about 2.15M (prompt, response) pairs.
Prompts are rendered as plain-text role labels ( user: , assistant: ) without a BOS token, and the response is followed by a trainable EOS that supplies the stop signal.
Each sample is truncated to a 4096-token canvas by reserving the response and its EOS first and left-truncating the prompt into the remainder.
Truncation therefore never removes response tokens unless the response alone exceeds the canvas (which almost never happens; only 1645 samples); it removes 16.2% of all prompt tokens, concentrated in the 2.5% of samples that do not fit the canvas. Figure 6 shows the prompt and response lengths before truncation, and Table 8 reports the token budget after it.
blocks.zh:
Dolci-Instruct-SFT的两个阶段列车都来自OLMo 3的训练后管道(Olmo Team,2025年).
混合物包括指令跟踪、数学、代码、谈话和工具使用实例。
我们使用完整的混合物,大约2.15M(即时,反应)对.
提示作为纯文本角色标签(user:, assistant: )提供,没有BOS令牌,响应后会有一个可训练的EOS提供停止信号.
每个样本通过将反应及其EOS先保留到一个4096个托肯的画布上,然后左转将提示排入其余部分.
因此,截断绝对不会移除响应符,除非单次响应超过画布(几乎从未发生;只有1645个样本);它移除了16.2%的所有即时信号,集中在2.5%的不符合画布的样本中. 图6显示截断前的迅速和答复长度,表8报告之后的象征性预算。

blocks.en:
Figure 6 : Empirical CDFs of prompt, response, and total length per sample in Dolci-Instruct-SFT, before truncation to the 4096-token canvas (vertical dotted line).
Response length includes the terminal EOS.
The horizontal dotted line marks the 97.5% of samples that fit the canvas.
blocks.zh:
图6:在Dolci-Instruct-SFT中,在切换到4096-token画布(垂直点线)之前,每个样本的快速,响应,和总长度的经验性CDF.
响应长度包括终端EOS.
水平点线标志着97.5%的样本符合画布.

blocks.en:
The benchmarks in Section B.4.3 are used only for downstream assessment.
We run no separate contamination check: every compared run trains on the same data, so any overlap with the benchmarks is shared by all of them.
blocks.zh:
B.4.3节中的基准仅用于下游评估。
我们没有进行单独的污染检查:每个比较运行的列车在同一数据上,所以任何与基准的重叠都由它们共享.

blocks.en:
The prompt is never masked, but not every masked position enters the loss: the response and its first EOS always do, and whether padding does depends on the setting ( Section B.4.1 ).
The MDM objective weights each sample by 1 / t 1/t ( Eq. 2.1 ), and we cap this factor at γ = 5 \gamma=5 , following the min-SNR weighting of Hang et al. (2023) .
In our runs, the cap slightly stabilizes training.
An auxiliary z z -loss is weighted 10 − 5 10^{-5} , and the loss is normalized by the number of positions it is computed on, not by the maskable ones.
blocks.zh:
提示从不蒙面,但并不是每个蒙面位置都进入损失:反应及其第一个EOS总是如此,是否粘贴取决于设置(B.4.1节).
MDM客观权重为每个样本的1 / t 1/t (Eq. 2.1 ),在Hang等人(2023年)的min-SNR权重之后,我们将该系数上限为 γ = 5\gamma= 5。
在我们的运行中,顶部略稳定训练.
辅助 z - 损失为加权 10 - 5 10 - 5 } 损失由它计算的位置数,而不是可遮掩的位置数而正常化。

blocks.en: Table 5 : Settings shared by the SFT and Post-SFT stages of LLaDA-8B.
blocks.zh: 表5:LLaDA-8B的SFT和SFT后阶段共用的设置.

blocks.en: B.4.1 SFT stage
blocks.zh: B.4.1 SFT阶段

blocks.en:
The SFT stage trains with the MDM objective in the same attention pattern the model later decodes with ( Table 6 ).
Full-canvas SFT attends bidirectionally over the whole canvas.
As in the SFT of Nie et al. (2025) , each local batch is padded with EOS only up to its longest sequence rather than to the full canvas.
In preliminary runs, we observed this made performance vary less with the canvas length.
Unlike Nie et al. (2025) , we keep these padding tokens out of the loss: they are attended and can be masked, but only the first EOS after the response is trained on.
In LLaDA, EOS and padding are the same token, and when we also trained on all the padding of the full canvas, the model collapsed to EOS or to very short responses, an effect Nie et al. (2025) also report.
Block diffusion SFT follows the vectorized block MDM algorithm of Arriola et al. (2025) with blocks of 32 tokens.
Each sample holds a clean and a noised copy of its response in one sequence of twice the length, and the attention mask lets each noised block attend to itself and to the clean blocks before it, so all blocks train in one forward pass.
We interleave the two copies block by block, which leaves this attention pattern unchanged.
Each response is rounded up to a whole number of blocks with EOS, and this filler enters the loss.
Both settings select the peak learning rate by a sweep at 1.5 1.5 epochs ( Sections F.1 and F.3 ).
blocks.zh:
具有MDM目标的SFT级列车的注意度相同,其型号后来也随之解码(表6).
SFT在整个画布上双向出席。
与Nie等人的SFT(2025年)一样,每批当地批次只加EOS最长的序列,而不是全画布.
在初步运行中,我们观察到这种制作的性能随着画布长度的不同而变化较小.
与Nie等人(2025年)不同的是,我们保留这些贴纸符记在损失中:它们被出席,可以被蒙上面具,但只有反应训练后的第一个EOS.
在LLaDA中,EOS和padding是同一个符号,当我们也接受过全画布所有padding的训练时,模型崩溃到EOS或极短的响应,一个效应Nie等人(2025年)也报告.
块扩散 SFT遵循Arriola等人(2025年)的矢量化块MDM算法,区块32个令牌.
每一个样本都有一个干净的和有噪声的回复副本,一个长度是两倍的序列,注意罩让每个有噪声的区块都注意自己和前面的干净区块,所以所有区块的列车都是在一个前方经过.
我们将两个副本逐块分开,使这种注意模式保持不变。
每个响应都用EOS进行整数块,这个填充器进入损失.
两种设置都选择峰值学习速率,在1.5个1.5个纪元时进行扫射(F.1和F.3节).

blocks.en:
Table 6 : SFT stage of LLaDA-8B.
Wall-clock time is the training run alone, without evaluation.
blocks.zh:
表6:LLaDA-8B的SFT阶段。
周六时间是训练单独进行,没有评价.

blocks.en: B.4.2 Post-SFT stage
blocks.zh: B.4.2 资助恐怖主义事件后 阶段

blocks.en:
Every Post-SFT run trains for 4000 updates at a peak learning rate of 2.5 × 10 − 6 2.5\times 10^{-6} , with a linear warmup over the first 200 updates (5% of the run) and cosine decay to 0 0 .
This is half the SFT peak, and together with the new warmup it keeps the continuation from the SFT checkpoint as smooth as the 4000-update horizon allows.
Full-canvas runs start from the 1.5-epoch full-canvas SFT checkpoint, and block diffusion runs start from the 6-epoch block diffusion SFT checkpoint.
Within each setting, every Post-SFT run therefore shares its warm start, data, recipe, and number of updates, and only the construction of the training sequences changes.
The Post-SFT MDM control uses the same recipe with the MDM training algorithm.
blocks.zh:
每个SFT后运行的列车在高峰学习率为2.5×10−6 2.5\times 10×6},在前200次更新(5%的运行量)和余弦衰变到0=0时进行线性热身.
这是SFT峰值的一半,再加上新的热身,它使SFT检查站的续作保持了4000更新视野允许的平滑.
全扫描仪从1.5世纪的全扫描仪SFT检查点开始运行,区块传播从6世纪的区块传播SFT检查点开始运行.
因此,在每个设置中,每个SFT后运行都分享其温暖的开始,数据,食谱,以及更新数量,只有训练序列的构建变化.
反恐行动后 MDM控制使用与MDM训练算法相同的配方.

blocks.en:
Progressive unmasking follows the construction in Section B.2 .
Each GPU keeps two trajectories, so that the 64 GPUs advance 128 trajectories per update, and every trajectory advances at every update.
Under block diffusion training, each block of 32 positions is its own trajectory, and all blocks of a sample advance in lockstep, so a block is retired after at most ⌈ 32 / u ⌉ \lceil 32/u\rceil steps.
The trajectories are not checkpointed, so a resumed run starts from fresh, fully masked ones.
The PU loss weights each sequence by min ⁡ ( 1 / t k , 5 ) \min(1/t_{k},5) , where t k t_{k} is the realized masked fraction of the positions in the loss: the response up to and including its first EOS on the full canvas, and each block separately under block diffusion.
It is rescaled by the fraction of sequences in the batch that still have masked positions in the loss, and it is averaged over the W W forward passes of a window.
The carry is the last hidden state after the final normalization, one vector per position, and it is added to the token embeddings through a LayerNorm whose weight and bias start at zero.
This LayerNorm is new at the start of Post-SFT and trains at the same learning rate as the rest of the model.
The carry is zero at the first step of a trajectory and is stored in fp32 between updates; the sum with the token embeddings is cast back to bfloat16 before the first transformer block.
Carry dropout is not used ( p = 1 p=1 ).

blocks.en: B.4.3 Evaluation

blocks.en:
We measure verifiable instruction following with IFEval ( Zhou et al., 2023 ) , mathematical reasoning with GSM8K ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) , and program synthesis with MBPP ( Austin et al., 2021b ) .
All three run in lm-eval 0.4.9.1 ( Gao et al., 2024 ) .
We report prompt-level strict accuracy on IFEval (0-shot), exact match with flexible answer extraction on GSM8K (8-shot), and pass@1 on MBPP (3-shot).
The score is the mean of the three.
Decoding uses the Fast-dLLM confidence-threshold policy ( Wu et al., 2026b ) .
It runs left to right in blocks of 32 tokens for every model, at temperature T = 0 T=0 , and sweeps the confidence threshold τ ∈ { 0.7 , 0.8 , 0.9 , 1 } \tau\in\{0.7,0.8,0.9,1\} . τ = 1 \tau=1 recovers one-token-per-step confidence decoding.
The generation budget is 1024 tokens for GSM8K and MBPP and 1280 tokens for IFEval, the values lm-eval sets per task.
Carry models pass the carry from each decoding step to the next.
On the full canvas, the carry also passes from one block to the next.
Under block diffusion, we reset the carry to zero at the start of every block, to match training, where the vectorized layout of Section B.4.1 advances all blocks of a sample in parallel from a zero carry.

We sweep the Gumbel-softmax temperature over { 0.5 , 1 , 2 } \{0.5,1,2\} and the REINFORCE weight over { 0.1 , 1 , 10 } \{0.1,1,10\} , with a leave-one-out baseline and normalized advantages, i.e., to reduce the variance of gradients, each sequence’s reward is compared with the average reward of the other sequences in the batch, and the resulting differences are rescaled to unit standard deviation.
The carry without BPTT ( W = 1 W{=}1 ) tracks PU throughout training, and supervising two steps per update without a carry adds little, whereas the carry trained by BPTT at W = 2 W{=}2 and W = 4 W{=}4 separates from both early in training ( Figure 10 , left ).
No discrete bridge exceeds the two-step objective without a carry ( right ), so the gain of Table 1 comes from training the carry through the following steps rather than from supervising several steps per update.
The same ordering holds at every decoding budget we evaluate, and the gap narrows at u = 16 u{=}16 , where every variant degrades ( Figure 11 ).

blocks.en: C.3 From teacher forcing to student forcing
blocks.zh: C.3 联合国 从老师强迫到学生强迫

blocks.en:
PU writes ground-truth tokens at the revealed positions ( Section 3.1 ), whereas at inference these positions hold the model’s own predictions.
We test whether scheduled sampling ( Bengio et al., 2015 ) , the standard remedy for this mismatch, improves PU on TinyGSM.
blocks.zh:
PU在所揭示的位置(第3.1节)上写地表真象,而推断这些位置是模型自己的预测。
我们测试计划采样是否(Bengio等人,2015年),这种不匹配的标准补救措施,改进了TinyGSM上的PU.

blocks.en:
We train PU without the carry, with the architecture and training budget of Table 4 .
For simplicity, we fix the number of stages to K = 12 K{=}12 instead of raising it from 12 to 42 as in Kim et al. (2026) , so that the student-forcing schedule is the only schedule that changes during training.
Each revealed position receives the ground-truth token with probability ε \varepsilon and the model’s argmax prediction otherwise, with a straight-through gradient through the predicted tokens.
The ratio ε \varepsilon follows the inverse-sigmoid decay of Bengio et al. (2015) with a floor, ε ⁡ ( s ) = max ⁡ ( 0.1 , k k + exp ⁡ ( s / k ) ) , \varepsilon(s)=\max\Bigl(0.1,\ \frac{k}{k+\exp(s/k)}\Bigr), where s s is the optimizer step after a 1,000 1{,}000 -step warmup and k k sets how fast training moves from teacher to student forcing.
We sweep eight values of k k from 15,542 15{,}542 to 98,862 98{,}862 , with one run per value, and report GSM8K accuracy at u = 2 u{=}2 as the mean of the last five evaluations.

Figure 12 shows that no schedule improves on the PU baseline ( 39.0 % 39.0\% ).
Accuracy increases with the average ratio of ground-truth tokens ε ¯ \bar{\varepsilon} and reaches the baseline only as ε ¯ \bar{\varepsilon} approaches 1 1 .
The two closest runs ( 37.5 % 37.5\% and 38.7 % 38.7\% ) have ε ¯ = 0.97 \bar{\varepsilon}=0.97 and 0.99 0.99 : their schedules never reach the floor and are almost pure teacher forcing.
Below ε ¯ ≈ 0.9 \bar{\varepsilon}\approx 0.9 , every run falls under the MDM baseline ( 34.3 % 34.3\% ), and at ε ¯ = 0.24 \bar{\varepsilon}=0.24 accuracy drops to 13.7 % 13.7\% .
In additional runs, detaching the predicted tokens instead of using the straight-through gradient changes accuracy by less than one point, so the drop comes from the predicted tokens in the context rather than from the gradient estimator.

blocks.en:
Committed positions are never revisited, so a wrong predicted token stays in the context for the rest of the trajectory, while the loss still asks for 𝐱 0 \mathbf{x}_{0} at the remaining masked positions.
The model is then trained to predict targets that contradict its own context.
The carry exposes each step to its predecessor’s imperfect computation through a continuous input, while the visible tokens stay consistent with 𝐱 0 \mathbf{x}_{0} ( Section 3.2 ).
The model can therefore learn how much to rely on the carry, and BPTT trains the predecessor to produce a useful one.

之后该模型被训练来预测与其自身背景相矛盾的目标.
随身携带通过连续输入将每个步骤暴露于其前身的不完善计算,而可见的符号则与x0\mathbf{x}_{0}(第3.2节)保持一致.
因此,该模型可以学习在多大程度上依赖于载荷,而BPTT训练前身来制作有用的载体.

We run the sampler used for evaluation: greedy decoding that, at each step, reveals the u u most confident masked positions and fills them with the most likely token.

Our MDM implementation first draws the number of masked positions and then masks a uniformly random subset of that size.
At ratio t t , we therefore draw N tr = 32 N_{\mathrm{tr}}=32 masks, each masking a uniformly random subset of round ⁡ ( t ​ N ) \mathrm{round}(tN) response positions. The PU construction of Kim et al. (2026) does not allow sampling a mask at a requested ratio: masks arise along trajectories whose reveal counts vary.
We therefore run the training construction itself on 𝐱 0 \mathbf{x}_{0} and collect the masks it produces. 1. We create a pool of 2 ​ K 2K trajectories, where K K is the number of stages the checkpoint was trained with.
Every trajectory is a copy of 𝐱 0 \mathbf{x}_{0} and starts at a random stage, as in training. 2. We advance the pool with the training update: reveal the most confident positions, reveal every position whose confidence exceeds 0.9 0.9 , and restart a trajectory from a new random stage once it is complete.
For carry models, the carry is passed along each trajectory; for W > 1 W>1 , the pool is advanced once per window of W W steps, as in Algorithm 1 . 3. At every step, we record the mask of each trajectory and assign it to the nearest ratio t t on the grid, if it lies within 0.05 0.05 of it.
Each ratio keeps at most N tr = 32 N_{\mathrm{tr}}=32 masks. We run each pool for K + 1 K{+}1 steps and use up to five independent pools, stopping once every ratio holds 32 32 masks.
At the checkpoints we report, all ratios are full for all problems.

blocks.en:
This section details the TinyGSM experiments behind Figure 2 ( Section 3.1 ).
We describe the runs and how we follow individual sequences ( Section D.1 ), report the sweep over u u and the ablations that separate the causes of the failure ( Section D.2 ), and explain why, at u = 2 u{=}2 , the loss of a sequence rises again before the sequence leaves the batch ( Section D.3 ).
blocks.zh:
本节详述图2(第3.1节)背后的TinyGSM实验.
我们描述运行情况以及如何遵循个别序列(D.1节),报告对uu的扫荡情况以及区分故障原因的擦伤(D.2节),并解释为何在u=2 u{=}2时,序列的丢失在离开批次之前再次上升(D.3节)。

blocks.en: D.1 Setup
blocks.zh: D.1 设置

blocks.en:
We use the model, data, optimizer and batch size of Section B.3 , with three changes that isolate the effect of u u .
First, each run lasts 3,000 3{,}000 updates: the learning rate warms up linearly over 600 600 updates and then stays at 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} , so that every insertion (below) happens at the same learning rate.
Second, the number of stages K K is fixed within a run, with K ∈ { 231,115 , 57 , 7 , 4 } K\in\{231,115,57,7,4\} , that is K ≈ L / u K\approx L/u for u ∈ { 2 , 4 , 8 , 64 , 128 } u\in\{2,4,8,64,128\} and the L ≈ 460 L\approx 460 maskable positions of a sample.
Third, the stage-indexed construction of Section B.2 runs without its confidence threshold τ \tau , so that no trajectory skips a stage: every trajectory has J = K J=K decoding steps, and every sequence stays in the batch for exactly J J updates.
The 32 32 trajectories of a GPU start at distinct stages drawn at random from { 0 , … , K − 1 } \{0,\dots,K-1\} when K > 32 K>32 , and cover all stages evenly otherwise.
There is no carry and no BPTT, and MDM follows the same schedule.
Each configuration is trained once.

第二,KK阶段的数量固定在跑道之内,K {{ 231 115, 57, 7, 4} K\in } 231 115, 57, 7, 4},即K { L / u K\\ 大约 L/u代表u {{2, 4, 8, 64, 128} u\ in {2, 4, 8, 64, 128} 和 L }}}} 460 L\\ 大约 460 个可以掩盖的样本位置。

blocks.en:
We follow 16 16 sequences from the validation split, which are not trained on otherwise.
Twelve of them are inserted into the batch, four at each of updates 750 750 , 1,500 1{,}500 and 2,250 2{,}250 , and the other four are never inserted.
Under PU, an inserted sequence takes the place of the next sequence to enter the pool of one GPU and starts at stage 0 0 ; it is then trained on for exactly J J consecutive updates, as one of the 256 256 sequences of each batch.
Under MDM, it replaces one sequence of one batch, for a single update.
In a separate run at u = 2 u{=}2 , we also followed the next 16 16 training sequences to enter the pool, at their natural times.
They respond like the sequences inserted in the same run, with a completion loss 65 % 65\% lower 20 20 updates after entry, so inserted sequences behave like ordinary training sequences.

我们遵循16个16个序列 从验证拆分, 这些没有经过其他训练。
其中12个被插入批次中,4个在更新750750,15001{,}500和2,2502{,}250中,另外4个从未插入.
在 PU 下,插入序列取代下一个序列进入一个 GPU 的池,开始于 0. 0 阶段;然后作为每批256 256 个序列之一,对它进行精确的 J J 连续更新的培训。
在MDM下,它取代一个批次的一个序列,用于一个更新.
在一次以u=2 u{=}2的单独运行中,我们也跟随接下来的16个训练序列进入游泳池,在他们自然的时间.
他们的反应就像在同一运行中插入的序列一样,在输入后,完成损失为65%65%xxx20下20更新,所以插入序列表现得像普通的训练序列.

blocks.en:
To measure how well the model predicts a sequence, we reveal its prompt and the first half of its answer, and average the cross-entropy over the rest of the answer, up to and including its first EOS; the padding that follows is not included in the loss.
This mask is the same throughout the run, and the loss is computed with the raw weights, not the EMA, after every update.
The validation completion loss averages the same quantity over 256 256 other validation sequences, computed every 20 20 updates, and we report its mean over the last 200 200 updates.
The relative completion loss of an inserted sequence is its completion loss divided by its mean over the 20 20 updates before insertion, divided by the same ratio for the validation completion loss, which removes the drift shared by all sequences. Figure 2 ( middle ) averages its logarithm over the 12 12 inserted sequences and smooths it over 9 9 updates; the bands show one standard error.

为了衡量模型对一个序列的预测程度,我们揭示了它的迅速和前半部分的答案,并平均地比起其余的答案,直到并包括其第一个EOS;下面的粘贴没有包括在损失中.
这种面具在整个运行过程中都是一样的,每次更新后,损失都是用原始重量而不是EMA计算出来的.
鉴定完成损失平均为256 256次其他鉴定序列的相同数量,每20次更新计算,我们报告在过去200次更新中的平均值。

blocks.en: D.2 Results
blocks.zh: D.2 结果

blocks.en:
Table 9 summarizes the runs of Figure 2 , and Figure 13 ( left ) plots their validation completion loss against u u .
As u u decreases, each sequence stays longer in the batch and a run visits fewer distinct sequences, 3.6 3.6 k at u = 2 u{=}2 against 768 768 k for MDM.
The inserted sequences are then fitted more deeply while they are in the batch, and the validation completion loss is higher: PU beats MDM when each sequence stays in the batch for only a few steps, but trails it for u ≤ 8 u\leq 8 .
At every u u , the gain has disappeared 300 300 updates after the sequence leaves the batch.
The training loss moves in the opposite direction ( Figure 2 , right ): at u = 2 u{=}2 , it falls to 0.07 0.07 , while the validation completion loss is 6.92 6.92 , the highest of the sweep.

blocks.en:
Table 10 changes one aspect of PU at a time, at u ∈ { 2 , 4 , 8 } u\in\{2,4,8\} , and Figure 14 follows the inserted sequences under the first two changes at u = 2 u{=}2 . • PU schedule, MDM masks. Each sequence still stays in the batch for J J consecutive updates, but every update draws a fresh MDM mask for it instead of advancing its trajectory.
The inserted sequences are fitted even more deeply, with a relative completion loss of 0.02 0.02 at u = 2 u{=}2 that is still 0.52 0.52 300 300 updates after they leave, and the validation loss is as high as with PU or higher.
The failure therefore does not come from the masks of PU ( Figure 14 , middle ). • Spread visits. Each GPU keeps a pool of 3,000 ⋅ 32 / J 3{,}000\cdot 32/J sequences, and each update advances the next 32 32 of them along their trajectories, so that a sequence is visited once every 3,000 / J 3{,}000/J updates, about 13 13 at u = 2 u{=}2 .
The trajectories, the number of visits per sequence and the number of distinct sequences are the same as with PU, but consecutive batches share no sequence.
The validation loss is higher than with PU at every u u : the model memorizes the whole pool over the run, with a training loss of 0.03 0.03 at u = 2 u{=}2 , instead of one batch at a time ( Figure 14 , right ).
Reuse is therefore what costs, and the consecutive visits of PU only make the overfitting local. • Initial stages 0 0 to 31 31 . Instead of drawing the initial stages at random, the 32 32 trajectories of a GPU start at stages 0 0 to 31 31 .
Since every trajectory lasts exactly J J updates, the whole pool then moves along the trajectory as a single window of 32 32 consecutive stages, and all losses oscillate with period J J .
The validation loss is much higher at u ≤ 4 u\leq 4 ; at u = 8 u{=}8 , where the window covers 32 32 of the 57 57 stages, it is unchanged.
This is the noise-level concentration of Section 4.3 , which here lasts for the whole run because no trajectory skips a stage. • No 1 / t 1/t factor. Every masked token gets the same weight, instead of the per-sequence normalization of Eq. 2.1 .
This deepens the drop at u = 2 u{=}2 , to a minimum relative completion loss of 0.36 0.36 , but changes the validation loss by at most 0.16 0.16 at every u u , including u ∈ { 64,128 } u\in\{64,128\} and MDM. • Batch of 128 128 sequences. Halving the batch makes each sequence a larger share of each update and halves the number of distinct sequences.
The drop deepens, to 0.37 0.37 at u = 2 u{=}2 , and the validation loss is higher at every u u .

表10一次更改PU的一个方面,在u {{2,4,8}u\in\2,4,8},图14沿用在u = 2 u\\2的前两个变化下的插入序列. ^ PU时刻表,MDM口罩. 每个序列仍留在批次中进行J J连续更新,但每次更新都为此绘制一个全新的MDM掩码,而不是推进其轨迹.

PU schedule, MDM masks. Each sequence still stays in the batch for J J consecutive updates, but every update draws a fresh MDM mask for it instead of advancing its trajectory.

Spread visits. Each GPU keeps a pool of 3,000 ⋅ 32 / J 3{,}000\cdot 32/J sequences, and each update advances the next 32 32 of them along their trajectories, so that a sequence is visited once every 3,000 / J 3{,}000/J updates, about 13 13 at u = 2 u{=}2 .
The trajectories, the number of visits per sequence and the number of distinct sequences are the same as with PU, but consecutive batches share no sequence.
The validation loss is higher than with PU at every u u : the model memorizes the whole pool over the run, with a training loss of 0.03 0.03 at u = 2 u{=}2 , instead of one batch at a time ( Figure 14 , right ).
Reuse is therefore what costs, and the consecutive visits of PU only make the overfitting local.

Initial stages 0 0 to 31 31 . Instead of drawing the initial stages at random, the 32 32 trajectories of a GPU start at stages 0 0 to 31 31 .
Since every trajectory lasts exactly J J updates, the whole pool then moves along the trajectory as a single window of 32 32 consecutive stages, and all losses oscillate with period J J .
The validation loss is much higher at u ≤ 4 u\leq 4 ; at u = 8 u{=}8 , where the window covers 32 32 of the 57 57 stages, it is unchanged.
This is the noise-level concentration of Section 4.3 , which here lasts for the whole run because no trajectory skips a stage.

Figure 14 : Inserted sequences under two ablations of PU, at u = 2 u{=}2 .
Each colored curve is the mean completion loss of the four sequences inserted at the same update, smoothed over 9 9 updates.
With MDM’s masks, an inserted sequence is almost memorized during its stay and forgotten after it; with spread visits, the model memorizes the inserted sequences over the rest of the run while the validation loss rises.
