blocks.en: D.3 Why the loss rises again before the sequence leaves the batch
blocks.zh: D.3 联合国 为何损失在序列离开批次前再次上升

blocks.en:
At u = 2 u{=}2 , the relative completion loss of an inserted sequence bottoms out about 50 50 updates after insertion, and three quarters of the drop are gone when the sequence leaves the batch, 231 231 updates after insertion ( Figure 2 , middle ).
At u = 4 u{=}4 and u = 8 u{=}8 , it keeps falling until the sequence leaves ( Table 9 ).
Diagnostics logged in further runs at the same settings explain this difference.
blocks.zh:
在 u = 2 u {=}2 时,插入序列底的相对完成损失在插入后约50个更新,当序列离开批次时,四分之三的滴滴消失,231个插入后更新(图2,中间).
在u = 4 u{=}4和u = 8 u{=}8时,它一直下降直到序列离开(表9).
在同一场合进一步记录的诊断说明这一差异。

blocks.en:
While an inserted sequence is in the batch, we log the loss of its trajectory on the answer tokens that are still masked, which is what training minimizes on this sequence, restricted to its answer ( Figure 13 , right ).
At u = 2 u{=}2 , this loss falls below 0.1 0.1 nats 55 55 updates after insertion, while 95 % 95\% of the answer is revealed only after 137 137 updates.
From then on, the sequence contributes almost no gradient, and the updates on the other sequences of the batch erase what it had taught the model.
At u = 4 u{=}4 , the trajectory fits its answer only 112 112 updates into its 115 115 -update stay, and at u = 8 u{=}8 it does not fit it at all ( 1.7 1.7 nats when the sequence leaves), so the completion loss keeps falling until the sequence leaves and rises only afterwards.
Revealing positions in a random order instead of by confidence still fits the trajectory early, 26 26 updates after insertion at u = 2 u{=}2 , and keeps a smaller rebound, so the reveal order is not its cause.
blocks.zh:
虽然一个插入的序列在批次中,我们记录其轨迹在仍被掩盖的答录符上的丢失,这就是训练在这个序列上最小化之处,仅限于答案(图13,右).
在 u = 2 u {=}2 时,这一损失低于 0.1 0.1 nats 55 55 插入后更新,而 95% 95 \% 的答案仅在 137 137 更新后被披露.
从那时起,序列几乎不贡献梯度,对批次其他序列的更新抹去它教给模型的东西.
在 u = 4 u {=} 4 时, 轨迹只符合其答案 112 112 更新到其115 - 更新停留中,在 u = 8 u u {=} 8 时,它根本不符合(序列离开时1.7 1.7 纳特),因此完成损失持续下降直到序列离开,仅在之后才上升.
以随机顺序而不是通过置信来揭示位置,仍然与轨迹早期吻合,在 u = 2 u {=}2 插入后更新26次,保持较小的反弹,因此显示顺序不是其原因.

blocks.en:
In two further runs at u = 2 u{=}2 with 24 24 inserted sequences, we record the stage at which each position is revealed, and follow the completion loss at each position of the second half of the answer, whose tokens are the targets of the completion loss.
Grouped by the stage at which they are revealed, the tokens of each group start degrading at their own reveal ( Figure 15 , left ).
Under confidence order, the 1,179 1{,}179 tokens revealed between stages 60 60 and 170 170 keep improving while they are still masked, by 0.62 ± 0.11 0.62\pm 0.11 nats between the bottom of the curve and their reveal, and their loss rises by 1.10 ± 0.07 1.10\pm 0.07 nats in the 50 50 updates after their reveal ( Figure 15 , right ).
Under random order, masked and revealed tokens both degrade by about 0.45 0.45 nats per 50 50 updates once the trajectory has fitted its answer, and the reveal does not change this rate.
A token’s prediction is therefore maintained only while the token remains a target that the trajectory has not fitted yet.
Under confidence order, the tokens that remain masked are the ones the model is least confident about, so they keep receiving gradient while the revealed ones are forgotten.
blocks.zh:
在两个附加运行中,以 u = 2 u {=} 2 加上 24 个插入序列,我们记录每个位置被揭示的阶段,并跟踪回答后半段每个位置的完成损失,其符号是完成损失的目标.
按揭发的阶段分组,每个团体的标志在自己揭发时开始退化(图15,左)。
在置信令下,60至170 170阶段之间显示的1 179 1{,}179个信使在仍蒙面的同时不断改进,在曲线底部和其揭示之间增加0.62±0.11 0.62\pm0.11纳特,在披露后50个更新中损失增加1.10±0.07 1.10\pm 0.07纳特(图15,右)。
在随机顺序下,蒙面和暴露的代币在轨迹装配了答案后,每50个更新时,均降解约0.45 0.45纳特,而暴露不会改变这个速率.
因此,只有在信物仍然是轨道尚未安装的目标时,才维持信物的预测。
在信任令下,仍然蒙着面的神物是模型最不自信的神物,所以它们不断接收梯度,而启示的神物却被遗忘.

Tokens: the second-half answer tokens of the inserted sequences, the targets of the completion loss. Left : tokens grouped into quartiles of the stage at which they are revealed; change in their completion loss relative to before insertion. Right : tokens revealed at stages 60 60 to 170 170 ; change relative to the 10 10 updates before their reveal (mean ± \pm one standard error).

The zero-infimum condition requires the carry-augmented sampler to approximate p ⋆ p^{\star} arbitrarily well under the reveal rule g g .
For u = 1 u=1 , the chain rule makes this a capacity assumption.
For u > 1 u>1 , each step draws its u u tokens independently given the state, so p θ p_{\theta} factorizes within each step and ε ⋆ \varepsilon^{\star} is generally positive; the corollary then applies only to AR models with δ > ε ⋆ \delta>\varepsilon^{\star} .

Both parts assume that training reveals positions as inference does. Part (i) holds along any teacher-forced trajectory, so it does not depend on the training u u . Part (ii), however, bounds the sampler that decodes with the training reveal rule, including its u u and its number of steps J J . Local overfitting forces us to train at a much larger u u than we decode with (effective training u ≈ 133 u\approx 133 to 67 67 on TinyGSM, against u = 2 u{=}2 at inference). So the bound does not directly cover the sampler we evaluate, which takes more steps and visits different states. We read it as a guarantee for an idealized, aligned setting. Whether the benefit carries over to the smaller inference u u is an empirical question: Figure 3 addresses it for masking patterns, and Table 2 for accuracy.

(i) Under teacher forcing, the committed tokens are the ground-truth values x 0 i x_{0}^{i} , which do not depend on θ \theta .
Without a carry, the input 𝐱 t j + r \mathbf{x}_{t_{j+r}} therefore depends on θ \theta only through the sets S 0 , … , S j + r − 1 S_{0},\ldots,S_{j+r-1} .
At a regular θ \theta , these sets are constant in a neighborhood of θ \theta (see the paragraph on regular parameters).
The input 𝐱 t j + r \mathbf{x}_{t_{j+r}} is thus locally constant, and d ​ ℒ ( j + r ) / d ​ θ \mathrm{d}\mathcal{L}^{(j+r)}/\mathrm{d}\theta equals the partial derivative with the trajectory held fixed.
Under Assumption 2 , regular points form a set of full measure.

(ii) The sets σ \sigma are constant near θ \theta , so near θ \theta the carries h j + 1 , … , h j + r h_{j+1},\ldots,h_{j+r} and the loss ℒ ( j + r ) \mathcal{L}^{(j+r)} are computed along the fixed trajectory defined by σ \sigma .
Within a window, the carry is never detached, and the chain rule along the path θ → h j + 1 → ⋯ → h j + r → ℒ ( j + r ) \theta\to h_{j+1}\to\cdots\to h_{j+r}\to\mathcal{L}^{(j+r)} gives G j , r σ G_{j,r}^{\sigma} .
With σ \sigma fixed, each carry is a composition of the maps ( θ , h ) ↦ f carry ​ ( 𝐱 t k , h ) (\theta,h)\mapsto f_{\mathrm{carry}}(\mathbf{x}_{t_{k}},h) , which are real-analytic by Assumption 1 .
The loss is analytic in the predicted probabilities, since they are positive at the target tokens.
Partial derivatives and products of real-analytic functions are real-analytic, so G j , r σ G_{j,r}^{\sigma} is real-analytic on the whole parameter space.
The dichotomy follows from the fact that the zero set of a real-analytic function that is not identically zero has Lebesgue measure zero ( Mityagin, 2020 ) .
At initialization, the zero-initialized LayerNorm maps every carry to zero, so ∂ ℒ ( j + r ) / ∂ h j + r = 0 \partial\mathcal{L}^{(j+r)}/\partial h_{j+r}=0 and G j , r σ G_{j,r}^{\sigma} vanishes; the same holds at every θ \theta where this LayerNorm has zero gain and bias.
Initialization alone therefore does not tell which of the two cases holds.
If the path crosses a window boundary, the carry is detached there, and the term is absent.

blocks.en:
Theorem 1 assumes that training uses the inference policy g g and applies the loss only to the positions each step reveals.
Our TinyGSM training uses the stage-indexed schedule of Kim et al. (2026) and applies the loss to all masked positions with the weighting of Eq. 2.1 , so the theorem describes an idealized version of it.
In particular, p θ p_{\theta} in Propositions 2 and 1 is the sampler that decodes with the training reveal rule. Whenever inference uses a smaller u u , as in all our experiments, the bound applies to that sampler and not to the one we evaluate.
The theorem also treats g W g_{W} as the sum of the window gradients at a single θ \theta , whereas Algorithm 1 divides each window’s loss by its length and updates θ \theta after every window, so it characterizes the fixed points of the idealized full-trajectory update rather than the iterates of Algorithm 1 .
The theorem bounds the excess KL of the sampler at points where the truncated gradient vanishes, and this bound decreases with W W ; it says nothing directly about the accuracy of the trained model. Theorem 2 concerns exact gradients.
Straight-through, relaxed and score-function estimators provide surrogate signals, which is why they can help but do not match the carry ( Section 3.2 ).
Finally, with teacher-forced commits, the gradient through the carry trains each step to pass useful information forward, not to correct its own committed errors.

我们的TinyGSM训练采用Kim等人(2026年)的舞台索引表,并将损失应用于所有蒙面位置,加权为Eq 2.1,因此定理描述了其理想化的版本.
特别是提议2和1中的p θ p_{\theta}是用训练解码规则的样本。 每当推论使用一个较小的u u,就像我们所有的实验一样, 约束适用于取样者而不是我们评价的。
定理还把g W gQQW} 当作单一\\theta 的窗口梯度之和, 而算法 1 则将每个窗口的损失除以长度, 并在每个窗口后更新\\theta , 因此它描述理想化的全射程更新的固定点, 而不是算法 1 的周期 。
定理将标本员的超量KL限制在截断梯度消失的点上,这个绑定随着W W 的减少;它没有直接说明训练过的模型的准确性. 定理2涉及精确的梯度.
直通、放松和记分功能的估算器提供代用信号,因此它们可以帮助但不能匹配载荷(第3.2节)。
最后,在教师强迫下,通过载运列车的梯度每一步都用来传递有用的信息,而不是纠正自己所犯的错误。

blocks.en:
All full-canvas Post-SFT runs start from an SFT checkpoint trained for 1.5 1.5 epochs (25k steps) with a cosine schedule.
We choose this length because SFT has largely saturated by then: doubling the schedule to 3 3 epochs (50k steps) raises the score at τ = 1 \tau=1 by 0.7 0.7 points, from 60.9 60.9 to 61.6 61.6 ( Figure 16 and Table 11 ).
At this length, we select the peak learning rate from { 10 − 8 , 10 − 7 , 10 − 6 , 5 × 10 − 6 , 10 − 5 , 10 − 4 } \{10^{-8},10^{-7},10^{-6},5\times 10^{-6},10^{-5},10^{-4}\} ( Figure 17 ).
The selection criterion is the score at τ = 1 \tau=1 , which decodes one token per step, as diffusion language models are usually benchmarked ( Nie et al., 2025 ; Ye et al., 2025 ) .
The peak learning rate 5 × 10 − 6 5\times 10^{-6} scores highest ( 60.9 60.9 , against 60.5 60.5 at 10 − 5 10^{-5} ), and its checkpoint is the starting point of all full-canvas Post-SFT runs.
The Post-SFT MDM control, which continues this checkpoint for 4000 steps, scores 61.2 61.2 against its 60.9 60.9 ; we attribute the small change to the short warm-up and re-annealing of the learning rate.
All scores use the chat prompt format ( Section B.4 ); Section F.8 compares them with published LLaDA results.
IFEval is the benchmark that gains the most from SFT, from 23.3 23.3 to 68.0 68.0 at τ = 1 \tau=1 , against 60.3 60.3 to 75.9 75.9 on GSM8K and 36.6 36.6 to 38.8 38.8 on MBPP ( Table 13 ).
This is consistent with the instruction-following focus of the Dolci-Instruct-SFT data.

blocks.en:
As on the full canvas, we select the learning rate for block diffusion SFT at 1.5 1.5 epochs (25k steps), with the score at τ = 1 \tau=1 as criterion ( Figure 19 ).
The peak learning rate 5 × 10 − 6 5\times 10^{-6} again scores highest ( 57.8 57.8 , against 57.4 57.4 at 10 − 5 10^{-5} ), and all block diffusion SFT runs use it.
Unlike the runs in Figure 20 , these sweep runs do not train on the EOS padding that completes the last block of each response, so their scores differ slightly from those runs. 2 2 2 Training on this padding also shortens generation: at τ = 0.9 \tau=0.9 , the 1.5 1.5 -epoch run of Figure 20 needs 135 135 NFEs, against 190 190 for the sweep run with the same learning rate.
Nonetheless, since all sweep runs share the same setting, we do not expect it to change the ranking of learning rates.

The score at τ = 1 \tau=1 rises from 57.2 57.2 at 1.5 1.5 epochs to 59.8 59.8 at 3 3 epochs and 61.4 61.4 at 6 6 epochs ( Figure 20 ), against a 0.7 0.7 -point gain from 1.5 1.5 to 3 3 epochs on the full canvas.
We attribute the slower convergence to the mismatch between the block-wise attention pattern, causal across blocks and bidirectional within the current block, and the fully bidirectional attention of LLaDA’s pre-training.
We therefore start the block diffusion Post-SFT runs from the 6 6 -epoch checkpoint (100k steps).
As on the full canvas, IFEval gains the most, from 23.3 23.3 to 65.4 65.4 at 6 6 epochs, against 60.3 60.3 to 77.0 77.0 on GSM8K and 36.6 36.6 to 41.6 41.6 on MBPP.

blocks.en: F.5 The limit case of u u equal to the block size in block diffusion
blocks.zh: F.5 联合国 u u 的限制大小等于块扩散中的块大小

blocks.en:
With a block size of 32 32 , a training step at u = 32 u=32 commits the whole block, so every trajectory lasts one step.
PU at u = 32 u=32 is therefore a limit case of PU: it only trains on fully masked blocks that follow a clean prefix.
At inference, every block starts from such a sequence, except that the model generated the prefix.
The later reveals within a block receive no Post-SFT training at u = 32 u=32 , so the model makes them with what it learned in pre-training and SFT.
blocks.zh:
区块尺寸为32 32,一个训练步骤在u = 32 u = 32 将整块填充,所以每个轨迹都会持续一个步骤.
PU at u = 32 u = 32因此是PU的限定例:它只在完全蒙蔽的块上进行列车,并遵循干净的前缀.
推论,每个块都从这样的顺序开始,只是模型产生了前缀.
后一街区内披露的在u = 32 u = 32 时没有接受 SFT 后训练,因此该模型用它在预训和 SFT 中学习到的东西来进行.

blocks.en:
PU at u = 32 u=32 reaches 63.1 63.1 at τ = 1 \tau=1 , against 62.0 62.0 for Post-SFT MDM ( Figure 24 ).
Its score–NFE curve also lies above those of PU at every other u u ( Figure 22 ).
We believe this gain comes from the short Post-SFT horizon of 4000 4000 steps: the model improves its first reveal of each block, and pre-training and SFT still let it complete the block.
The later reveals receive no training signal, so we expect a longer Post-SFT at u = 32 u=32 to collapse.
blocks.zh:
PU在u = 32 u = 32时达到63.1 63.1,在 \ = 1\ tau = 1时,而SFT MDM后为62.0 62.0(图24)。
它的得分–NFE曲线也高于所有其他uu的PU(图22).
我们相信这一收益来自于短小的SFT后4000步的视野:模型改进了对每个街区的首次披露,预训和SFT仍然让它完成这个街区.
后期的显示没有收到训练信号,所以我们期望一个更长的SFT后U=32u=32崩溃.

blocks.en:
We cannot apply BPTT at u = 32 u=32 because the trajectory length is 1 1 . Figure 24 compares PU at u = 32 u=32 with PU at u = 16 u=16 , alone and with BPTT at W = 2 W=2 , the configurations reported in Section 4.2 .
We observe that the score–NFE trade-off of PU at u = 16 u=16 with BPTT at W = 2 W=2 dominates that of PU at u = 32 u=32 , although PU alone at u = 16 u=16 scores lower ( 62.1 62.1 against 63.1 63.1 ).
The best reveal count without BPTT is therefore not necessarily the best one with it: a smaller u u with BPTT can match or exceed a larger u u that rules BPTT out.
Our experiments do not isolate why u = 32 u{=}32 suits PU alone; the cause may lie in our setup (model, dataset, and benchmarks), in the optimization issues of small u u ( Sections 4.3 and F.6 ), or in the decode block of 32 32 .

blocks.en: F.6 Model collapse as a function of training u u
blocks.zh: F.6 模型崩溃作为培训的功能 uu

blocks.en: In Section 4.3 , we present the effect of decreasing the training u u on the learning dynamics. Below, we provide more evidence of the challenges brought by small training u u , which we trace to three factors: sample diversity, noise diversity, and the objective mismatch.
blocks.zh: 在第4.3节中,我们介绍了减少培训对学习动态的影响。 下面,我们提供更多证据,说明小型训练(u u)所带来的挑战,我们追踪到三个因素:样本多样性,噪声多样性,以及客观不匹配.

blocks.en: PU-style training causes consecutive steps to visit similar sequences: a sequence not yet fully unmasked at step t t reappears at step t + 1 t+1 , one unmasking step further along its trajectory. At a fixed token budget, training therefore covers a smaller set of distinct sequences ( Figure 5 ) and keeps each of them in the batch for many consecutive steps, which is what makes the model overfit locally ( Section 4.3 ). Figure 25 measures how long sequences stay in the batch, by the Jaccard similarity—the intersection over union—between the sequences visited by two steps Δ \Delta apart. We estimate it from the dynamics observed on a single machine in a multi-GPU run and extrapolate to the full run. Small training u u yields substantially higher overlap that persists over large Δ \Delta , whereas larger u u shows a faster decay as Δ \Delta increases. Confidence collapse dampens the effect: by committing several high-confidence positions at once, it allows sequences to complete in fewer steps and be replaced sooner.
blocks.zh: PU式的训练导致连续步骤访问相似的序列:一个序列尚未在步 t 上完全解开,在步 t + 1 t+1 上重新出现,沿着其轨迹再解开一步. 因此,在固定的象征性预算中,培训包括一套较小的、不同的序列(图5),并且连续许多步骤将每个序列保留在批量中,这就使得模型在当地过于适合(第4.3节)。 图25用Jaccard的相似性来测量批次中序列的长度, 我们从一个多GPU运行的单机上观测到的动态来估计,并推导到全程. 小训练 u 产生相当高的重叠, 持续在大型的 \\ Delta 上, 而较大的 u 显示更快的衰减, 信心的崩溃抑制了这种效应:通过同时承诺几个高度自信的位置,可以使序列在更少的步骤中完成并更早被替换.

blocks.en: Figure 25 : Intersection over union of samples within the training batch Δ \Delta training steps apart across training u u : (a) PU training without confidence collapse; (b) PU training with confidence collapse; (c) PU training without confidence collapse when sampling batches from a pool of training trajectories 10 × \times the size of the batch.
blocks.zh: 图25:培训批次内样本结合的交叉 Δ\Delta培训步骤  apart  training  training  training  training  training  training  training  training  training  training  training  training  training    training \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ × × × × ×

blocks.en:
PU-style training iterates through sequences by progressively unmasking them, starting from fully masked sequences. Early in training the number of visible tokens across a batch is therefore concentrated near 0 0 . MDMs are not subject to this effect, as noise levels are drawn i.i.d. per sample at every training step. Figure 26 illustrates this behavior. We track the standard deviation, across training batches logged every 10 10 steps, of the number of unmasking steps each sequence has undergone. For all training u u , the standard deviation starts near zero as all the sequences are fully masked and grows as sequences complete and are renewed at different times. What changes between u u is the pace at which this mixing happens: for u = 1 u{=}1 , the progression toward reaching a steady state is longer than for u = 32 u{=}32 and u = 128 u{=}128 , for which it can happen at a pace the logging frequency cannot track. While this mixing is slower at low u u , it affects only the first few hundred training steps, so we expect its impact on the general performance to diminish as the number of training steps increases.
Two further factors shape this mixing. Sequences differ in length and are completed after different numbers of steps, so the within-batch noise-level distribution broadens as training progresses. In block diffusion, the parallel-block implementation unmasks u u tokens per block, so a small training u u corresponds to a higher effective number of tokens unmasked per step across the sequence.
blocks.zh:
PU式的训练通过序列通过逐渐解开它们,从完全蒙蔽的序列开始进行. 因此,在培训初期,整个批次的明显标志的数量集中在接近0。 计量吸入器不受这种影响,因为每个培训阶段的每个样本都得出噪音水平。 图26说明了这种行为。 我们追踪标准偏差,每10个步骤记录的训练批次,每一步骤的卸牌次数。 对于所有训练u u ,标准偏差开始于接近0,因为所有序列都被完全遮掩,随着序列的完整而增长,在不同的时间被更新. uu之间的变化是这种混杂发生的速度:对于u = 1 u{=}1,向稳定状态发展的进展比u = 32 u{=}32 和 u = 128 u{=}128 的时间要长,为此可以以伐木频率无法跟踪的速度发生. 虽然这种混合在低u u 中速度较慢,但只影响前几百个训练步骤,因此我们预计随着训练步骤的增加,它对一般表现的影响会减少.
还有两个因素决定了这种混合。 顺序在长度上有所不同,经过不同的步骤后完成,因此随着训练的进展,批内噪声级分布会扩大. 在块扩散中,平行块执行每块unmasks u u 令牌,所以一个小的训练u u对应的是更高有效数量的每个步骤跨序的未蒙面的令牌.

blocks.en: PU-style training computes the loss over all masked tokens, akin to MDMs. The weight given to uncommitted positions is therefore not set directly but follows from u u : as u u decreases, the ratio of supervised to committed positions grows, and the gradient is increasingly dominated by predictions at positions the step does not commit. A single hyperparameter thus governs both the granularity of the trajectory and the balance of supervision between committed and uncommitted positions. Interestingly, Xia et al. (2026) propose an alternative loss which decouples the two, defining the loss as a weighted sum of the term over all masked tokens and the term over committed tokens alone.
blocks.zh: PU式训练计算所有蒙面符号的损失,类似于MDM. 因此,对未承诺职位的权重不是直接设定的,而是根据uu:随着uu的减少,被监督职位与被承诺职位的比例增加,梯度越来越以该步骤未承诺位置的预测为主。 因此,一个单一的超参数既管辖轨迹的颗粒性,也管辖已承诺和未承诺位置之间的监督平衡。 有趣的是,Xia等人(2026年)提出了一种使两者脱钩的替代损失,将损失定义为所有蒙面标志和仅承诺标志上的词语的加权总和。

All runs use full-canvas diffusion without confidence collapse. The dotted line refers to the mean computed on the last 3,000 training steps.

blocks.en: F.6.1 Mitigating the gap at small train u u
blocks.zh: F.6.1 联合国 缩小小火车的差距 u u

blocks.en:
We attempt to mitigate the effect of training with a small u u by targeting the three
factors identified above: sample diversity, noise diversity, and
the objective mismatch.
blocks.zh:
我们试图减轻训练的效果 用一个小uuu,
上述因素:样本多样性、噪音多样性和
客观不匹配。

blocks.en:
We maintain a pool of P P training sequences, ten times
larger than the training batch size B B . At each training step s s , rather than
advancing the sequences seen at s − 1 s-1 , we advance the next B B sequences in the pool.
Consecutive steps therefore visit non-overlapping sets of sequences
( Figure 25 c) and the number of distinct sequences seen over
training increases. This comes at a cost in memory: the
pool holds P P sequences and their masks rather than B B , and the overhead grows further
with carry and BPTT, which store additional tensors per sequence. In practice, this
bounds the pool size we can reasonably use.
blocks.zh:
我们保留了十个PP训练序列
大于培训批号BB。 在每一个训练步骤 S,而不是
推进在S -1s -1上看到的序列, 我们推进下一个B序列 在游泳池。
因此,连续步骤访问非重叠系列
(图25c)和所看到的不同序列的数目
培训增加。 这需要代价来纪念:
池内有P序列和面具,
带有载体和BPTT,每个序列存储额外的载体。 在实践中,
限制我们可以合理使用的池子大小。

blocks.en:
We initialize training from partially unmasked sequences, with
masking ratios sampled uniformly. Figure 26 shows the effect on
early training at u = 1 u{=}1 : PU with random initial masking ratios maintains a higher
within-batch standard deviation than PU from the first step onward.
blocks.zh:
我们从部分解开的序列中初始化训练
统一取样的遮盖比率。 图26显示对以下各项的影响:
早期训练, u = 1 u{=}1 : PU 随机初始遮罩比率维持较高
内批标准偏差比 PU 从第一步开始。

blocks.en:
Finally, we explicitly
balance the contributions of the tokens to be unmasked at the current step against
those of the remaining masked tokens. Xia et al. (2026) propose a weighted sum of
two cross-entropy terms, one over all masked tokens and one over the tokens revealed at
the current step: ℒ MS k = w k ​ [ λ ​ ℓ k dense + ( 1 − λ ) ​ ℓ k reveal ] , w k = n k N m , \mathcal{L}_{\text{MS}}^{k}=w_{k}\Big[\lambda\,\ell_{k}^{\mathrm{dense}}+(1-\lambda)\,\ell_{k}^{\mathrm{reveal}}\Big],\qquad w_{k}=\frac{n_{k}}{N_{m}}, (F.1) where n k n_{k} is the number of positions revealed at step k k , N m N_{m} the total number of
maskable positions, and ℓ k dense \ell_{k}^{\mathrm{dense}} and ℓ k reveal \ell_{k}^{\mathrm{reveal}} the

blocks.en: In Figure 27 , we apply these changes to PU-style full-canvas training, where the top- u u tokens are unmasked at each step; at inference we use the Fast-dLLM policy and vary the confidence threshold τ \tau . Together, these changes substantially reduce the performance gap at small u u without closing it. Additionally, these tricks cost memory and tuning effort and only partially mitigate collapse; the simpler alternative remains to choose a training u u that trades off training–inference alignment against healthy dynamics.
blocks.zh: 在图27中,我们将这些修改应用到PU风格的全扫描仪训练中,其中顶部-u u 符符符在每一步骤上都被解密;推论我们使用快速dLLM策略,并更改置信阈值\\tau 。 这些变化加在一起,大大缩小了小uu的性能差距,而没有缩小。 此外,这些伎俩花费了记忆力和调试努力,而且只是部分缓解崩溃;更简单的选择仍然是选择一种以培训为交换条件的uu-推论结合健康动态。

blocks.en: These three effects make it impractical to do PU at small u u , while this is the regime typically targeted at inference (e.g., unmask ≃ 8 \simeq 8 tokens at a time). Beyond memory and tuning, the adjustments above are also harder to integrate with complementary techniques such as the carry or BPTT.

blocks.en: Block diffusion allays this trade-off. With blocks of b b tokens, all advancing in parallel, a sequence stays in the batch for at most ⌈ b / u ⌉ \lceil b/u\rceil steps instead of about L / u L/u , so that at the same u u it is reused L / b L/b times less ( Sections 4.2 and B.4.2 ). This is consistent with block diffusion being less exposed to the loss of sample diversity ( Figure 5 ) and with no value of u u fully collapsing in that setting ( Section F.4 ).

blocks.en: F.7 Relevance of confidence thresholding at training time
blocks.zh: F.7 在培训时确定信任门槛的相关性

blocks.en:
All PU and BPTT runs outside this subsection use a training-time confidence threshold τ train = 0.9 \tau_{\text{train}}=0.9 , the default of Kim et al. (2026) , who find PU mostly insensitive to the threshold except for very extreme values (e.g., τ ≤ 0.65 \tau\leq 0.65 ).
Each training step commits every masked position whose confidence exceeds τ train \tau_{\text{train}} and, if fewer than u u qualify, the most confident remaining positions up to u u ( Sections 4 and B.2 ).
Here we compare it with a threshold-free variant that commits exactly u u positions per step.
blocks.zh:
所有PU和BPTT运行于本小节之外,均使用训练时间信任阈值=0.9\tau_{\text{train}}=0.9,是Kim等人的默认值(2026年),他们发现PU除极极值外,大多对阈值不敏感(例如: ^ 0.65\tau\leq 0.65).
每个训练步骤都执行每个遮掩姿势,其信任度超过\ tau_{\text{train}}},如果低于uu合格,则最有信心的剩余姿势最高为u(第4节和B.2节)。
在这里,我们把它与一个没有门槛的变体进行比较,这个变体每个步骤都承诺准确的u u 位置.

blocks.en:
The threshold has two effects.
First, it brings training trajectories closer to those of the confidence-threshold decoding used at inference.
Second, it acts on the small- u u optimization issues of Section 4.3 : positions the model already predicts confidently are committed at once, so the model spends fewer steps on tokens it already knows and trajectories end sooner.
As a result, a run visits more distinct samples ( Figure 28 ).
At u = 1 u=1 , a run with the threshold visits 0.6 % 0.6\% of the samples the Post-SFT MDM control visits, against 0.3 % 0.3\% without.
The difference shrinks as u u grows and is within the uncertainty bands from u = 8 u=8 on ( 2.5 % 2.5\% against 2.3 % 2.3\% ).
We estimate the number of samples a run visits from the mean number of response tokens revealed per step, divided by the mean response length measured on the Post-SFT MDM control. 3 3 3 Training logs one rank every tenth step, so the exact count is not recorded.
A trajectory ends only once all its response tokens are revealed, so each sample contributes exactly its response length and the ratio counts samples.
The bands are one standard error, combining the variation in response length over the logged rows and a block bootstrap over logged steps, with blocks of one trajectory length.

blocks.en:
Table 13 compares our measurements with published LLaDA-8B values.
These are the only external numbers in the paper; every other comparison is between runs that share the data, decoding policy, and evaluation harness.
With the plain prompt format ( Section B.4 ), our harness reproduces the published base figures.
All other results use the chat prompt format ( Section B.4 ), which matches the format of our SFT data.
With it, the base model scores 10.1 10.1 points lower on GSM8K, 3.2 3.2 lower on MBPP, and 2.4 2.4 higher on IFEval.
The prompt format is fixed across all our runs, so this shift does not affect our comparisons, but our absolute scores should not be compared directly with published ones.

blocks.en: Appendix G Relation to the closest work
blocks.zh: 附录G 与最近工作的关系

blocks.en: Our contribution concerns how to train masked diffusion models for the trajectories they encounter during generation: which states to train on, what information to propagate between them, and how far to propagate the learning signal. PUMA ( Kim et al., 2026 ) , Loopholing ( Jo et al., 2026 ) , MetaState ( Xia et al., 2026 ) , and Relay ( Rozonoyer et al., 2026 ) establish complementary foundations for these questions. Building on them, we study trajectory alignment with the inference policy and temporal credit assignment via BPTT together, evaluate their contribution to general-purpose instruction post-training, and investigate the conditions under which closer alignment remains learnable.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献涉及如何为他们在一代人中遇到的轨迹培训蒙面传播模型:这些模型规定如何培训,在它们之间传播哪些信息,以及传播学习信号有多远。 PUMA(Kim等人,2026年),Loopholing (Jo等人,2026年),Metastate(Xia等人,2026年),Relay(Rozonoyer等人,2026年)为这些问题建立了互补的基础. 在此基础上,我们共同研究与推断政策和通过BPTT进行时间信用分配的轨迹调整,评价它们对通用教学培训的贡献,并调查在何种条件下仍然可以学习更加密切的调整。

blocks.en:
Kim et al. (2026) establish progressive unmasking as an effective training strategy, with a marginal-agreement guarantee under idealized posterior sampling. We build on their teacher-forced trajectories: the policy selects reveal positions, but ground-truth commitments still differ from an imperfect model’s sampled content. Our carry adds the predecessor’s model-produced representation, providing a weak form of student forcing and a differentiable path from later losses to earlier computations.
PUMA also recognizes that long chains can provide redundant supervision and motivates a coarse-to-fine schedule partly by the unreliable policy early in training. Its schedule increases the number of stages, reducing the fraction of each sequence revealed per step, whereas inference includes two- and three-token steps. 4 4 4 In the paper’s notation, K K refers to the number of stages, which increases from 12 12 to 42 42 for the case of TinyGSM; the number of unmasked tokens per step is then nominally L / K L/K , with L L close to 512 512 . The confidence threshold makes the measured value significantly larger ( Section B.2 ). Its schedule ablations already suggest that matching the reveal order need not mean matching its granularity.
Our post-training results show that small-count degradation persists with a pretrained, instruction-tuned denoiser. An informed policy does not by itself ensure a learnable trajectory. We trace it to local overfitting caused by sample reuse ( Section 4.3 ), and also examine masking-level diversity and the balance of supervision on committed versus uncommitted positions ( Appendix F ), connecting schedule sensitivity to concrete learning dynamics. PUMA’s large-model experiments establish effectiveness in a specialized setting: LoRA adaptation of a code model, evaluated on HumanEval and MBPP. Our full-model, general instruction post-training tests a broader question: whether the gains extend to instruction following while retaining reasoning and code capabilities, under both full-canvas and block diffusion.
blocks.zh:
金 al等. (2026年)将逐步脱口露面确立为有效的培训战略,在理想化的后采样下提供边际协议保障. 我们以他们的教师强化路线为基础:政策选择揭示了立场,但地面真相承诺与不完善模式的抽样内容仍然不同。 我们的载荷增加了前身的模型化代表,提供了一种无力的强迫学生的形式,以及从后来的损失到早期计算的不同路径。
PUMA还认识到,长链可提供冗余的监督,并在一定程度上由于培训初期不可靠的政策而促使制定粗细至精细的时间表。 它的排程会增加阶段的数量,减少每个步骤所揭示的每个序列的分数,而推论则包括两脚步和三脚步. 4 4 4 在论文的注解中,K K提到阶段数,对于TinyGSM来说,阶段数从12个12个增加到42个42个;每个步骤的未面额符号数则名义上是L / K L/K,L L接近512 512 . 置信阈值使所测值大得多(B.2节)。 它的排版已经表明,匹配显示顺序并不一定意味着匹配其颗粒性.
我们的训练后结果显示,小学校退化现象持续存在,而且有事先受过训练的、经过指导的教师。 知情政策本身并不能确保可学习的轨迹。 我们追踪到因重新使用样本而导致的局部过度调整(第4.3节),并检查遮掩层面的多样性以及对承诺位置和非承诺位置的监督平衡(附录F),将时间表敏感性与具体学习动态联系起来。 PUMA的大型模型实验在专门环境下确立了有效性: LoRA对一个代码模型的修改,在HumanEval和MBPP上评价. 我们的全模式、一般训练后测试是一个更广泛的问题:在全面扫描和块状扩散下,收益是否扩大到以下的教学,同时保留推理和密码能力。

blocks.en:
Jo et al. (2026) establish the value of retaining continuous information across discrete sampling. They name the underlying limitation the sampling wall : collapsing each predicted distribution to a single token discards what the model knew about the alternative tokens, and the carry lets part of this information survive the commitment. We adopt their simple, empirically effective hidden-state carry to isolate the role of training and trajectory alignment with minimal architectural changes. Their self-conditioning pass takes a corrupted sequence and an empty carry, then supplies its detached output (with stop-gradient) to a second prediction on the same sequence. Our cached carry instead comes from the preceding rollout step, which itself consumed its predecessor’s carry after trajectory initialization. We therefore hypothesize that this recurrent history better matches inference-time conditioning than a context generated in isolation, while recognizing that teacher-forced token content still leaves a mismatch. A stored carry that crosses an optimizer update was also produced by the parameters before that update.
Loopholing reports approximately 30 % 30\% additional training time. Our caching approach removes its auxiliary context-generation pass, thus avoiding this additional training cost, and replaces it with storage of one hidden-width vector per token, rather than a vocabulary-sized distribution. This is a compact representation relative to logits, although total storage still scales with sequence length and the number of active trajectories. Within each unroll window, we can also train the computation that produced the carry through subsequent losses. PUMBA thus develops a multi-step training direction, combining recurrent conditioning with temporal credit assignment. The removed auxiliary pass and the additional memory and computation of BPTT are separate costs, and we provide more details on this trade-off between them in Table 7 .
blocks.zh:
约等. (2026)确定在分散取样中保留连续信息的价值。 他们列举了取样墙的内在限制: 将每个预测的发行量倒塌到一个符号上, 我们采用简单、经验有效的隐藏状态,将培训和轨迹调整的作用与最低限度的建筑变化分开。 他们的自我调节通道需要一个腐烂的序列和一个空载,然后将其脱落的输出(带有停止升级)供给到同一个序列上的第二次预测. 我们的缓存载具来自前一个推出步骤,它本身在轨迹初始化后消耗了其前身的载具。 因此,我们假设,这种反复出现的历史比孤立产生的背景更符合推断时间的假设,同时认识到教师强迫的象征性内容仍然留下不匹配之处。 穿越优化器更新的存储载体也由更新前的参数生成.
循环报告大约30% 30 +%的额外培训时间。 我们的缓存方法取消了它的辅助上下文生成通道,从而避免了这种额外的训练费用,取而代之的是每个符号存储一个隐藏的width矢量,而不是词汇大小的分布. 这是一个相对于对数的紧凑表示,尽管总存储仍然有序列长度和活动轨迹的数量的尺度. 在每一个不滚动窗口中,我们也能够训练产生后继损失的运算. 因此,PUMBA制定了多步骤的培训方向,将经常性条件与时间信贷分配相结合。 取消的辅助通行证和BPTT的额外内存和计算是单独的成本,我们在表7中提供了它们之间这种权衡的更多细节.

blocks.en: Residual Context Diffusion (RCD; Hu et al., 2026 ) and DiffusionGemma ( DiffusionGemma Team, 2026 ) carry a different quantity from the backbone hidden state we adopt from Loopholing. Both pass the expected input embedding 𝐄 ⊤ ​ 𝐩 \mathbf{E}^{\top}\mathbf{p} to the next step, where 𝐩 ∈ Δ | 𝒱 | \mathbf{p}\in\Delta^{|\mathcal{V}|} is the predicted distribution at a position and 𝐄 ∈ ℝ | 𝒱 | × d \mathbf{E}\in\mathbb{R}^{|\mathcal{V}|\times d} is the input embedding table. The resulting vector 𝐄 ⊤ ​ 𝐩 ∈ ℝ d \mathbf{E}^{\top}\mathbf{p}\in\mathbb{R}^{d} has the same width as the hidden-state carry. RCD entropy-weights this residual. It trains the target model using residuals supplied by a frozen reference model, then recursively feeds back the target model’s own predictions at inference. DiffusionGemma applies a temperature to the logits before computing 𝐩 \mathbf{p} and passes the expected embedding through a feedforward network, which yields a self-conditioning signal for the next denoising step. Adapting such carries to our trajectory-trained setting is an interesting direction.
blocks.zh: 残留的上下文分泌(RCD;Hu等人,2026年)和DifupulationGemma(DifupulationGemma Team,2026年)携带着与我们从Loopholing所采纳的骨干隐藏状态不同的量. 两者将预期输入嵌入 E 的 p\ mathbf{ E\\top\ mathbf{p} 传递到下一步, 其中 p\\\\ v\ mathbf{ p\\\\\\ Delta\ mathcal{ V\\\ 是一个位置的预测分布, E\\\ R\\ V\\\ d\ mathbb{ R\\ mathcal{ V\\ times d} 是输入嵌入表 。 由此产生的矢量 E ⊤ p ∈ R d \ mathbf{ E}^{\top}\ mathbf{p}\in\ mathbb{R}^{d}的宽度与隐藏状态载体相同. 刚果民盟的Entropy重量是这种残余。 它利用冷冻参照模型提供的残留物来训练目标模型,然后在推论中递归回馈目标模型自己的预测. DifunusionGemma在计算 p\ mathbf{p} 之前对日志应用温度,并通过一个向导网络传递预期的嵌入,这个网络为下一个去诺步骤产生一个自我调节信号. 使这种载体适应我们的轨道训练环境是一个有趣的方向。

blocks.en:
Xia et al. (2026) address the information island : continuous computations are lost between denoising steps when only discrete token decisions persist. Their fixed-size working memory improves reasoning with a frozen backbone. Their objective also combines supervision on all masked positions with a term focused on the positions about to be revealed. This emphasis connects to trajectory alignment, and we investigate a loss following that design in our small- u u analysis ( Sections 4.3 and F ).
Both approaches train recurrent state through unrolling, but MetaState uses random reveal orderings and Dirichlet–Multinomial reveal counts, whereas its decoder is confidence-based. PUMBA follows the model’s unmasking policy and updates the denoiser itself, thus better aligning with our training–inference alignment objective. MetaState uses four unrolled steps by default and reports broadly stable performance over K ∈ { 3 , 4 , 5 } K\in\{3,4,5\} . These steps partition the entire training trajectory; our window W W instead truncates gradients along trajectories that can span multiple updates.
MetaState trains on 50k examples from the general-purpose Tülu-3 mixture and evaluates mathematical reasoning and code generation. Our distinction is not general-purpose training data alone: we study full-model instruction post-training and explicitly evaluate instruction following alongside reasoning and code. Their work advances memory architecture and efficiency, while we fix a minimal carry to isolate training and alignment choices. Therefore, we do not compare the architectures directly; combining more effective or compact memories with PUMBA is an important direction for future work ( Section 6 ).
blocks.zh:
霞等编. (2026年)针对信息岛:当只有单独的象征性决定持续存在时,在取消提名的步骤之间将失去连续计算。 他们固定大小的工作记忆用冷冻的骨干改善了推理. 其目标还将对所有蒙面职位的监督与侧重于即将披露职位的术语结合起来。 这一重点与轨迹调整有关,我们调查了在我们小的uu分析中(第4.3和F节)设计后的损失。
这两种方法都通过不滚动来训练经常性状态,但MetaState使用随机的披露命令和Dirichlet – 多功能披露计数,而其解码器则基于信心。 PUMBA遵循这个模式的不假政策, MetaState默认使用四个未滚动步骤,并报告在K {} { 3, 4, 5} K\in}3,4, 5} 上基本稳定的性能. 这些步骤分隔了整个训练轨迹;我们的窗口W转而沿可跨越多个更新的轨迹缩短梯度。
MetaState列车以通用Tülu-3混合物的50k例列车,评价数学推理和代码生成. 我们的区别不仅仅是一般用途培训数据:我们学习训练后的全模教学,并明确评价教学与推理和代码。 他们的工作提高了记忆结构和效率,同时我们确定一个最小的载荷,以隔离培训和调整选择。 因此,我们不直接比较这些架构;将更有效或更紧凑的记忆与PUMBA相结合是未来工作的一个重要方向(第6节)。

blocks.en:
Concurrent work by Rozonoyer et al. (2026) is particularly close: it combines model-selected, teacher-forced rollouts with differentiable per-token state and truncated BPTT. It includes rollout-only and detached-carry (i.e., with stop-gradient) controls in both Sudoku and Fast-dLLM v2 (1.5B). The latter is adapted on a code-and-mathematics mixture and evaluated on HumanEval and MBPP. Our setting is general instruction post-training of LLaDA-8B: we evaluate instruction following as the target capability and mathematical reasoning and code generation for capability retention, under both full-canvas and block diffusion.
Relay’s results also motivate studying the components across settings: the detached carry gives a substantial gain on Sudoku, while the language-model results show a different balance between rollout accuracy and the NFE benefit of temporal training. Their large-model study establishes effectiveness for a two-step unroll within block diffusion. We broaden this evidence by jointly varying training-trajectory granularity and the unroll horizon at 8B scale, under both full-canvas and block decoding: the question is how reliably the benefits extend across post-training configurations, and what controls their magnitude. In particular, we characterize when closer alignment improves the quality–NFE frontier, when repeated states and concentrated masking levels impair learning, and how targeted interventions mitigate these effects ( Sections 4.3 and F ). This analysis provides practical guidance for carry-based post-training beyond establishing that a differentiable channel can help.
blocks.zh:
Rozonoyer等人(2026年)同时进行的工作特别接近:它结合了模型选择,教师强制的推出与可分异的每趾状态和截断的BPTT. 它包括在数都库和Fast-dLLM v2(1.5B)中,只推出和脱离式载体(即带有停级)控制. 后者在代码和数学混合物上进行了调整,并在HumanEval和MBPP上进行了评价。 我们的设定是LLaDA-8B培训后的一般教学:我们评价以下的教学作为目标能力以及数学推理和代码生成,以保留能力,同时在全面扫描和块传播下。
中继结果也激发了对不同设置的组件的研究:脱落的载荷给数独带来很大收益,而语言模型的结果表明,推出精度与时间训练的NFE效益之间有不同的平衡. 他们的大型模型研究确定了在块状扩散中双步无卷的功效. 我们通过在全扫描和区块解码下共同不同训练-弹射颗粒度和8B级的未滚动视野来拓宽这一证据:问题是如何可靠地在训练后配置中扩大效益,以及控制其规模的是什么。 特别是,我们描述的是,何时更紧密的配合能提高NFE的前沿质量,何时反复出现状态和集中的遮掩水平会妨碍学习,以及定向干预如何减轻这些影响(第4.3和F节)。 这一分析为基于载体的后期培训提供了实际指导,超出了确定不同渠道可以帮助的范围。
